english: The Mattawamkeag River gathers its eastern and western branches in the forested interior and flows southwest to meet the Penobscot. The confluence joins a tributary of the northeastern woods to the larger river flowing south toward the sea, while the branches reach back into the inland country. From the junction of the two branches, the Mattawamkeag runs for about fifty miles before reaching the Penobscot.
simp_chinese: 马塔瓦姆基格河的东、西两支在森林内陆汇合，向西南流入佩诺布斯科特河。汇流处将东北林地的一条支流接入向南流向大海的大河，其源流则伸向内陆。两条源流汇合之后，马塔瓦姆基格河流经约五十英里，才抵达佩诺布斯科特河。

english: Maba lies on the eastern side of Halmahera, among the bays and forested mountains of the northern Moluccas. Once known as Mobon, it was one of the three districts called Gamrange, together with Patani and Weda. Their local rulers, known as #italic sangaji#!, held authority within the wider Sultanate of Tidore. Tradition places their incorporation into Tidore's realm around the early seventeenth century, after neighboring Jailolo lost its independence.
simp_chinese: 马坝位于哈马黑拉岛东侧，坐落在北摩鹿加的海湾与森林山地之间。它曾称莫邦，与帕塔尼、韦达共同组成称为加姆兰格的三个地区。当地称为#italic 桑加吉#!的统治者在蒂多雷苏丹国的广大疆域内掌握地方权力。传统认为，在邻近的贾伊洛洛失去独立后，这些地区约于十七世纪初加入蒂多雷的疆域。

english: Mabale lies near Mushenge, the site of Nsheng, capital of the Kuba federation. Between the Kasai, Sankuru and Lulua rivers, Kuba rulers presided over a collection of communities that included the Bushoong and Kete. Around 1625, Shyaam a-Mbul a Ngoong brought several chiefdoms together; later Kuba nobles commissioned elaborate raffia textiles, carved cups and masks for court ceremony.
simp_chinese: 马巴莱靠近穆申盖，也就是库巴联盟都城恩申所在之地。在开赛河、桑库鲁河和卢卢阿河之间，库巴统治者管理着包括布雄人和凯特人在内的多个社群。约1625年，希亚姆·阿姆布尔·阿恩贡将几个酋邦联合起来；此后的库巴贵族为宫廷仪式订制了精美的拉菲草织物、雕刻酒杯和面具。

sources.title: Pre-colonial history of the Democratic Republic of the Congo

english: Mabein lies in the northern Shan country along the Shweli River, between the Irrawaddy valley and the uplands of Möng Mit. The river cuts through wooded hills before descending towards the great Burmese waterway. Mabein formed part of the territory of the Möng Mit saopha, whose state included both river valleys and the mineral-rich hills towards Mogok. Its settlements lay on routes joining the highlands to the Irrawaddy basin.
simp_chinese: 马本位于北部掸地的瑞丽江沿岸，介于伊洛瓦底江谷地与孟密高地之间。河流穿过森林山丘，向缅甸的大河流去。马本曾属于孟密土司的领地，这个政体既包括河谷，也包括通往抹谷、富产矿石的山区。当地聚落处在连接高地与伊洛瓦底江流域的道路上。

english: Mabian lies in the forested mountains of southern Sichuan, along a river flowing towards the Min. Yi communities and hereditary chiefs long inhabited the surrounding uplands. In 1764 the Qing established Mabian department under Xuzhou prefecture, drawing together several districts formerly administered from Pingshan with newly demarcated lands. The new officials faced a mountainous country whose villages and fields were separated by steep ridges and streams.
simp_chinese: 马边位于川南林木茂密的山区，河水从这里流向岷江。彝族社群和世袭土司长期居住在周围高地。1764年，清廷设马边厅，隶属叙州府，将原属屏山的若干乡与新划定的地区合并管理。新官府面对的是山岭和溪流分隔村落田地的山区。

english: Mabila was a fortified town in the Alabama interior, part of the country ruled by the chief Tuskaloosa. Its wooden palisade enclosed houses and a plaza. In October 1540 Hernando de Soto's Spanish expedition arrived with Tuskaloosa, whom it had taken under guard while demanding supplies and porters. Warriors gathered inside the town, and a confrontation erupted into a fierce battle. The Spaniards set Mabila ablaze; many Indigenous people were killed, and the expedition suffered heavy losses and lost its baggage in the fire.
simp_chinese: 马比拉是阿拉巴马内陆一座设防城镇，属于首领塔斯卡卢萨统治的地区。木栅环绕着房屋与广场。1540年10月，埃尔南多·德·索托的西班牙远征队来到这里；此前他们要求补给与搬运工，并将塔斯卡卢萨置于看管之下。战士们聚集在城内，双方冲突演变成激烈战斗。西班牙人放火焚烧马比拉，许多原住民遇难；远征队也损失惨重，行李在火中付之一炬。

english: Mábù lies in the tea-growing hills of western Ānhuī. The settlement became a centre for collecting tea from the surrounding mountains; a purchasing station was established here during the Sòng. Tea from the wider Lù’ān region acquired a lasting reputation, and by the Míng and Qīng periods it was sent to the imperial court as tribute.
simp_chinese: 麻埠位于皖西产茶的山地，是收集周围山茶的集镇。宋代这里已设茶站。六安一带的茶叶长久享有声誉，至明清时期已作为贡品送入朝廷。

english: Mabunda is the country of the Mbunda, whose communities lived in eastern Angola and western Zambia. Historical accounts place people called Mabunda in the country east and northeast of the Barotse floodplain. Rivers cross the wooded land before joining the upper Zambezi, while grasslands and seasonal wetlands border the larger watercourses. The Mbunda maintained connections with neighbouring peoples of the Zambezi basin.
simp_chinese: 马本达是姆本达人居住的地区，他们的社群分布于安哥拉东部和赞比亚西部。历史记载将称为马本达的居民置于巴罗策洪泛平原以东及东北的土地上。河流穿过林地，汇入赞比西河上游；较大的水道旁则有草地与季节性湿地。姆本达人与赞比西河流域的邻近族群保持联系。

english: Mabuya lies in the countryside near Chambas in central Cuba. An Indigenous archaeological site beside the local river bears the name, preserving evidence of settlement before the changes brought by Spanish colonization. The surrounding region stretches toward the northern coast and its offshore cays. Historical records also mention the vegas of Mabuya in the seventeenth century, when rural estates and cultivated land formed part of the colonial landscape.
simp_chinese: 马布亚位于古巴中部尚巴斯附近的乡间。当地河流旁有一处以此命名的原住民考古遗址，保留了西班牙殖民改变这一地区之前的聚落证据。周围地域向北伸至海岸与外海礁岛。历史记录还提到十七世纪的马布亚河谷田地，当时乡村庄园与耕地已成为殖民景观的一部分。

english: Mabveni was an early farming settlement on a hill in the country near Mount Buhwa. Pottery, clay figures and the remains of grain stores recall a community that lived here long before the great stone centres of the plateau arose. Iron slag and fragments of furnace equipment show that its inhabitants worked metal, while beads of glass, copper and ostrich eggshell point to a variety of materials valued in their daily and social lives.
simp_chinese: 马布韦尼是布赫瓦山附近一处山顶上的早期农耕聚落。陶器、陶俑和粮仓遗迹，让人想起远早于高原上宏伟石建中心兴起时便生活在这里的社群。铁渣和炉具残片显示居民加工金属；玻璃珠、铜珠与鸵鸟蛋壳珠，则展示了他们在日常和社交生活中珍视的多种材料。

english: Macaca was an Indigenous district of eastern Cuba, south of Bayamo and near the coast of the Gulf of Guacanayabo. Its name survives in accounts of the island before the Spanish conquest. Early histories place an initial Spanish settlement called San Salvador in this country, near Niquero and Cape Cruz, before the town was moved inland toward the Bayamo River. The region thus witnessed some of the first stages of colonial settlement in Cuba.
simp_chinese: 马卡卡是古巴东部的原住民地区，位于巴亚莫以南，靠近瓜卡纳亚沃湾海岸。岛屿被西班牙征服之前的记载保存了它的名称。早期历史著作将名为圣萨尔瓦多的最初西班牙聚落置于这一地区，靠近尼克罗和克鲁斯角；城镇后来迁往内陆巴亚莫河一带。这里因此见证了古巴殖民定居的最初阶段。

english: Macaclita lay among the peoples of the Calamuchita valley and the eastern slopes of the Comechingones mountains. Streams descending from the highlands join here to form the Río Tercero, whose waters continue towards the Paraná. The valley's fertile sediments and dependable water supported settlement long before Spanish rule, leaving traces at archaeological sites along the river.
simp_chinese: 马卡克利塔人生活在卡拉穆奇塔谷地及科梅钦戈内斯山脉东坡。山间溪流在谷地汇成特塞罗河，河水继续流向巴拉那河。肥沃的沉积土与稳定的水源很早便吸引人们在此定居，河岸考古遗址留下了西班牙统治以前的生活痕迹。

english:
Macaregua became the site of San Juan de Girón in the Colombian Andes. Francisco Mantilla de los Ríos founded the colonial town in 1631; after illness and a locust plague, it was moved to Macaregua in 1638. Set near the Río de Oro, Girón lay on routes between the mountain settlements and the Magdalena valley. Its whitewashed houses and churches grew around the town’s central square.

The surrounding country formed part of Santander, where Indigenous communities had long occupied the valleys before Spanish colonization. Colonial agriculture and exchange linked Girón to neighbouring towns and the river routes beyond the eastern mountains and valleys. The town’s relocation illustrates the importance of local conditions to settlement in a landscape of steep slopes, valleys and streams.

The later city of Bucaramanga lies here.
simp_chinese:
马卡雷瓜后来成为哥伦比亚安第斯山中圣胡安德希龙的所在地。弗朗西斯科·曼蒂利亚·德洛斯里奥斯于1631年建立殖民城镇；疾病与蝗灾后，城镇于1638年迁至马卡雷瓜。希龙靠近奥罗河，位于山地聚落与马格达莱纳河谷之间的道路上，白墙民居和教堂围绕中心广场发展。

周围地区属于桑坦德，西班牙殖民之前原住民社群已在山谷中长期生活。殖民时期的农业与交换将希龙同邻近城镇及山外河路相连。城镇的迁移显示，在山坡、谷地和溪流交错的环境中，地方条件对聚居十分重要。

后来的布卡拉曼加即位于此地。

english: Macas lies east of the Ecuadorian Andes, where mountain rivers enter the forested lands of the upper Amazon. The surrounding country was home to the Shuar before Spanish settlements appeared in the sixteenth century. In 1599 Shuar forces rose against colonial demands and attacked the towns of Logroño and Sevilla del Oro. Their resistance dealt a severe blow to Spanish rule in the region.
simp_chinese: 马卡斯位于厄瓜多尔安第斯山脉以东，山间河流在此进入亚马孙上游的森林地带。十六世纪西班牙聚落出现之前，周围是舒阿尔人的家园。1599年，舒阿尔人反抗殖民当局的征索，袭击了洛格罗尼奥和塞维利亚德尔奥罗。这场抵抗沉重打击了西班牙人在当地的统治。

english:
Macassa is a sheltered bay at the western end of Lake Ontario, separated from the open lake by a long beach. Its waters and the marsh to the west were part of Indigenous life for centuries. The bay was named Burlington Bay in 1792, and settlers established homes around its shores. During the War of 1812, nearby Burlington Heights became a military position; soon afterwards George Hamilton promoted a village south of the bay, which was named as the seat of the new Gore District in 1816.

The later city of Hamilton lies here.
simp_chinese:
马卡萨是安大略湖西端的一处避风海湾，一条长长的沙洲将它与开阔湖面分开。几个世纪以来，湾水与西面的沼泽都是原住民生活的一部分。1792年，海湾被命名为伯灵顿湾，移民逐渐在沿岸定居。1812年战争期间，附近的伯灵顿高地成为军事阵地；不久，乔治·汉密尔顿推动在湾南建立村落，1816年这里被指定为新设戈尔地区的行政中心。

后来的哈密尔顿即位于此地。

english: Macaúba lies in the country between the Araguaia and Tocantins rivers, near lands inhabited by the Apinajé. The Apinajé are a Jê-speaking people whose villages occupy the wooded savannas of this interfluve. Their territory is crossed by streams flowing toward the great rivers, and their communities preserve a close relationship with the land, paths and waterways that connect them.
simp_chinese: 马考巴位于阿拉瓜亚河与托坎廷斯河之间，靠近阿皮纳耶人的土地。阿皮纳耶人操热语族语言，村落分布在这片河间地带的林地与稀树草原中。流向两条大河的溪流穿过他们的领地，社区与土地以及连接各地的道路、水道保持着密切关系。

english: The Tuvalu sea is a wide expanse of Pacific water dotted with low islands and reefs. Polynesian settlers established communities on these islands long before European voyages reached them. In 1781 Francisco Mourelle sailed past Nanumea at the northern end of the chain while attempting a passage from the Philippines towards New Spain.
simp_chinese: 图瓦卢海是一片辽阔的太平洋水域，低岛与礁盘散布其中。欧洲船只到来之前，波利尼西亚移民已在这些岛上建立社群。1781年，弗朗西斯科·穆雷列试图从菲律宾横渡太平洋前往新西班牙，途中驶过岛链北端的纳努梅阿。

english: The waters of Tuvalu separate small coral islands scattered across the Pacific. Islanders made sea voyages between their homes, and traditions preserve connections with Samoa and Tonga. In 1819 Arent de Peyster sighted Funafuti and Nukufetau from the Rebecca; the name Ellice, which he gave to Funafuti, came to be applied to the group.
simp_chinese: 图瓦卢水域分隔着散布于太平洋中的小珊瑚岛。岛民在各自的家园之间航行，传统中保存着与萨摩亚及汤加的联系。1819年，阿伦特·德·佩斯特乘丽贝卡号望见富纳富提和努库费陶；他赋予富纳富提的埃利斯之名后来被用于整组岛屿。

english:
Macaya was an earlier name associated with Azángaro, a settlement on the northern Peruvian altiplano. The town lies in the river country north of Lake Titicaca, amid high grasslands and valleys inhabited by Indigenous communities. In the late eighteenth century it became a major centre of rebellion against Spanish colonial rule.

After Túpac Amaru II was captured in 1781, his relative Diego Cristóbal Túpac Amaru continued the struggle and established a rebel headquarters at Azángaro. Pedro Vilca Apaza, a leader from the area, fought royalist forces in the surrounding highlands. The town remained a stronghold of the movement for months and became a centre of resistance in the northern altiplano, until rebel leaders accepted a pardon and laid down arms; the war left the plateau deeply disrupted.
simp_chinese:
马卡亚是与阿桑加罗有关的早期地名。这座聚落位于秘鲁北部高原、的的喀喀湖以北的河流地区，周围是高寒草地和原住民社群居住的河谷。十八世纪末，它成为反抗西班牙殖民统治的重要中心。

1781年图帕克·阿马鲁二世被俘后，其亲属迭戈·克里斯托瓦尔·图帕克·阿马鲁继续斗争，并在阿桑加罗设立起义总部。当地领袖佩德罗·比尔卡·阿帕萨在周围高地与保皇派作战。城镇数月间一直是起义的据点和高原北部的抵抗中心，直到起义领袖接受赦免并放下武器；战争给高原带来了深重动荡。

english: The Maccan River winds through the country south of the Chignecto Isthmus toward the tidal waters of the Bay of Fundy. Along with the Nappan and Hébert rivers, it formed part of a network of Mi'kmaw travel routes and provided fish and other resources. The river's name is associated with a Mi'kmaw word for a fishing place. By the middle of the eighteenth century an Acadian settlement had also grown in the district, near the marshes and waterways of the upper bay.
simp_chinese: 马坎河蜿蜒流经希格内克托地峡以南，通向芬迪湾的潮汐水域。它与纳潘河、埃贝尔河共同构成米克马克人的交通网络，并提供鱼类等资源。河名与米克马克语中捕鱼地点的名称相关。到十八世纪中叶，这一地区也出现了阿卡迪亚聚落，坐落在海湾上部的沼泽和水道附近。

sources.title: A list of Micmac names of places, rivers, etc., in Nova Scotia

english: Macclesfield is a Cheshire market town on the western edge of the Pennines. Silk working began as a household trade, including the making of buttons, before water-powered machinery transformed production. In the 1740s Charles Roe built a silk throwing mill in the town, drawing on machinery developed at Derby. Other mills followed, and the spinning and weaving of silk became central to Macclesfield's economy in the late eighteenth and early nineteenth centuries.
simp_chinese: 马科斯菲尔德是柴郡的一座集镇，位于奔宁山脉西缘。丝绸加工最初是家庭手工业，包括制作纽扣，后来水力机械改变了生产方式。十八世纪四十年代，查尔斯·罗在镇上建造缫丝厂，采用在德比发展出的机械。此后更多工厂建立，纺丝与织绸成为十八世纪末至十九世纪初当地经济的核心。

english: Macedo de Cavaleiros lies in the interior of northeastern Portugal, among lands once occupied by fortified hill settlements. A royal inquiry in 1258 recorded the territory as belonging to knights Nuno Martins and Mendes Gonçalves; Macedo was then a small settlement beside more prominent neighbors. Its name is associated with the knight Martim Gonçalves de Macedo, remembered for defending the Master of Aviz at the battle of Aljubarrota in 1385. References to Macedo dos Cavaleiros appear in documents after the fourteenth century.
simp_chinese: 马塞杜德卡瓦莱鲁什位于葡萄牙东北内陆，周围土地上曾分布着设防的山丘聚落。1258年的王室调查记载，这片土地属于骑士努诺·马丁什和门德什·贡萨尔维什；当时马塞杜只是一个小聚落，附近有更显著的地方。它的名字与骑士马丁·贡萨尔维什·德马塞杜相联系，相传他在1385年阿尔茹巴罗塔战役中保护了阿维什骑士团团长。十四世纪以后，文书中开始出现马塞杜多什卡瓦莱鲁什的名称。

english:
Macenta lies in the forested highlands of southeastern Guinea, in a region inhabited by Loma-speaking communities. The hills and valleys form part of the source country of several rivers, and the forests to the south have long supplied kola nuts sought by merchants from the savanna. Northern Mande speakers called the forest region worodugu, the land of kola. Loma communities and their neighbours maintained their own languages and institutions while participating in exchanges that joined the forest to the interior.

The later city of Voinjama lies here.
simp_chinese:
马森塔位于几内亚东南部森林高地，处在洛马语社群居住的地区。当地丘陵与河谷是多条河流的源头，南方森林长期出产可乐果，吸引草原地带的商人前来。北曼德语使用者称森林地区为“沃罗杜古”，即“可乐果之地”。洛马社群及其邻居保有各自的语言与制度，同时参与连接森林和内陆的交换网络。

后来的沃因贾马即位于此地。

english:
Macerata stands on a hill between the Potenza and Chienti valleys in the Marche. It became a commune in 1138, and its university traces its origins to 1290. In 1320 Pope John XXII transferred an episcopal see to the town, strengthening its institutional importance within the Papal States.

In the sixteenth century the town's defences and civic spaces were altered; the merchants' loggia dates from 1504–1505. The scholar Gerolamo Zoppio founded the Accademia dei Catenati in 1574. During the upheavals of 1799, fighting and the entry of French troops were followed by looting.
simp_chinese:
马切拉塔位于马尔凯地区，坐落在波滕扎河与基恩蒂河谷之间的山丘上。它于1138年成为自治市，大学的渊源可追溯至1290年。1320年教宗若望二十二世将主教座迁至此地，增强了其在教宗国中的机构地位。

16世纪，城镇防御设施和公共空间得到改造；商人凉廊建于1504至1505年。学者杰罗拉莫·佐皮奥于1574年创立卡泰纳蒂学会。1799年的动荡中，战斗和法国军队入城之后发生了劫掠。

english: Macha lies on the right bank of the Lena, in the forested country downstream from the mouth of the Vitim. The Lena here receives rivers from the Patom highlands on one side and the Lena plateau on the other. The nearby mouths of the Bolshoy and Maly Patom mark the meeting of mountain waters with the great river, which continues north towards the Arctic through the long Siberian winter and brief summer.
simp_chinese: 马恰位于勒拿河右岸，在维季姆河口下游的森林地带。这一河段两侧的支流分别来自帕托姆高地和勒拿高原。附近大、小帕托姆河口是山中水流与勒拿大河的交汇处；大河继续向北流向北冰洋，沿途经历漫长的西伯利亚冬季和短暂夏季。

english: Machakh lies near the Yana, beside Lakes Stary and Malakh in northern Yakutia. The great river runs north through this country toward its delta on the Laptev Sea. Lakes and channels lie among the northern forests and open ground, surrounded by the mountains of the Verkhoyansk region. The long winter freezes the waterways; the short summer brings the brief season of open water.
simp_chinese: 马恰赫位于雅库特北部亚纳河附近，靠近斯塔雷湖和马拉赫湖。大河向北流经这片地区，通向拉普捷夫海上的三角洲。湖泊与水道散布于北方森林和开阔地之间，周围是上扬斯克地区的群山。漫长冬季水道冰封，短暂夏季才带来开水时节。

english: Machala lies in the warm coastal lowlands south of the Gulf of Guayaquil. During the colonial period its orchards produced cacao known for its aroma, a crop carried into the trade of the Guayaquil region. The settlement formed part of the jurisdiction of Puná by 1573; in the seventeenth century colonial governors expanded cacao cultivation in the surrounding low country.
simp_chinese: 马查拉位于瓜亚基尔湾以南温暖的海岸低地。殖民时期，周围园地生产以香气著称的可可，进入瓜亚基尔地区的贸易网络。1573年，这座聚落属于普纳辖区；十七世纪，殖民总督又在周围低地扩大可可种植。

english: Machame lies on the slopes of Kilimanjaro, where the great mountain rises above the dry plains of East Africa. Streams descend through deep valleys, watering the cultivated belt below the forest. The Chagga communities of the mountain established numerous small chiefdoms, while people speaking Ongamo and other languages also inhabited its slopes. Bananas and grain grew alongside the livestock kept by households in this varied upland environment.
simp_chinese: 马查梅位于乞力马扎罗山坡上，这座大山高耸于东非干旱平原之上。溪流穿过深谷流下，滋养森林下方的耕作地带。山上的查加社群建立了众多小型酋邦，讲翁加莫语等语言的人群也居住在山坡。居民在多样的高地环境中种植香蕉和谷物，同时饲养牲畜。

english: Machang lies among the mountains south of the old Xilong seat. The surrounding country belonged to the Anlong chieftaincy, governed by hereditary local rulers under Sicheng. In 1666 the Qing abolished the chieftaincy and established Xilong prefecture under appointed officials. The scattered settlements of this upland region became part of the new prefecture, which linked the Guangxi hills with the borders of Guizhou and Yunnan.
simp_chinese: 马场位于西隆旧州治以南的山地。周边原属安隆长官司，由世袭土官治理，隶属泗城。清康熙五年（1666年），朝廷裁撤安隆土司，改设西隆州，由流官治理。山地间分散的聚落随之纳入新州，其辖境连接广西山地与贵州、云南交界地带。

english:
Machaqa belongs to the Aymara highland world south of Lake Titicaca. Cold plateau conditions encouraged varied forms of production: communities grew hardy crops and kept llamas and alpacas for food, fibre and transport. Exchange with lower valleys supplied products unavailable at higher elevations, while communal relationships and household obligations helped organise land and labour.

In the late medieval period, Aymara polities in the wider region came under the expanding Inca state. Labour and goods were demanded through imperial networks of roads and administrative centres. Spanish conquest later changed tribute, religion and labour, including obligations associated with colonial mining. Indigenous authorities continued to mediate between households and external rulers, while Christian institutions coexisted with older practices.
simp_chinese:
马查卡属于的的喀喀湖以南的艾马拉高地地区。寒冷高原上的社群种植耐寒作物，饲养羊驼和美洲驼，获取食物、纤维和运输工具。与低海拔河谷的交换提供高地缺少的物品，社群关系和家庭义务则帮助组织土地及劳动。

中世纪后期，广大地区的艾马拉政体进入不断扩张的印加国家。帝国通过道路和行政中心征发劳力与物资。西班牙征服后来改变了贡赋、宗教和劳动制度，其中包括殖民矿业所需的劳役。原住民当局继续在家庭与外来统治者之间协调，基督教机构也与较早的习俗并存。

english:
Machecoul lies in the country of Retz south of the Loire, where a castle guarded a town on the edge of the coastal marshes. It was a seat of the lords of Rais, among them Gilles de Rais, marshal of France and companion of Joan of Arc. Arrested at his castle in 1440, he was tried and executed at Nantes for crimes including the murder of children.

In March 1793 rural insurgents opposed to the Revolution entered Machecoul. Over the following weeks more than a hundred and fifty Republicans were killed in and around the town. The violence became one of the early massacres of the Vendée uprising, bringing civil war to a place whose castle had already been linked to a notorious chapter of Breton history.
simp_chinese:
马什库勒位于卢瓦尔河南方的雷地区，城堡守护着沿海沼泽边缘的城镇。它是雷领主的驻所，其中包括法国元帅、圣女贞德的战友吉尔·德雷。1440年，他在城堡被捕，随后因谋杀儿童等罪名在南特受审并处决。

1793年3月，反对革命的乡村起义者进入马什库勒。此后数周，城镇及周围有一百五十多名共和派人士被杀。这场暴力成为旺代起义初期的大屠杀之一，内战波及这座城堡早已与布列塔尼一段骇人历史相关的城镇。

english: Machekha lies in the forest-steppe of the Khopyor and Buzuluk country, where Cossacks and settlers from Ukrainian lands established villages along the southern frontier. Local tradition connects its name with migrants from a village of the same name near Poltava. The settlement's history reaches back to the seventeenth century, when the Don river communities were expanding along their tributaries. The name carried a memory of the settlers' former home into the new country.
simp_chinese: 马切哈位于霍皮奥尔河与布祖卢克河地区的森林草原，哥萨克人和乌克兰土地上的移民曾在南部边疆沿河建立村庄。当地传统将村名与波尔塔瓦附近同名村庄的移民联系起来。聚落的历史可追溯至十七世纪，当时顿河社区正沿支流扩展。这个名字将定居者对故乡的记忆带到了新的土地。

english:
Mǎchéng stands at the southern foot of the Dàbié Mountains on the upper Jǔ River, where Húběi meets Hénán and Ānhuī. Its name comes from Mǎ Qiū, a general of the Later Zhào, and in 598 the Suí made it a county under Huángzhōu. Under the Míng it belonged to Huángzhōu Prefecture; in the Jiājìng reign Huáng'ān County was cut from Mǎchéng, Huánggāng and Huángpí.

Mǎchéng was the gathering point of the great Míng migration from Húguǎng to Sìchuān. In a study of fifty-eight genealogies from Chóngqìng, Héchuān, Nánxī and Guǎng'ān in Sìchuān, eighty-five of the 118 families that had come before the Qīng were from Húguǎng, and sixty-five of those were from Mǎchéng. The thinker Lǐ Zhì, who styled himself the Old Man of Lónghú, spent years at the lake near the town before he died in a Beijing prison in 1602.
simp_chinese:
麻城位于大别山中段南麓、举水上游，是鄂、豫、皖三省交界处。后赵石勒部下麻秋筑城防守，始有麻城之名；隋开皇十八年（598年）置麻城县，属黄州。明代属黄州府，嘉靖年间以麻城、黄冈、黄陂三县各一部分设黄安县。

麻城是明代湖广填四川的集散地。对重庆、合川、南溪、广安的58份族谱的研究表明，清代以前入川的118户中，湖广籍85户，其中65户来自麻城。思想家李贽自号龙湖叟，曾长期寓居城边的龙湖一带，1602年死于北京狱中。

english: Macheng was an old county south of Luanzhou, on the plain near the Luan River. It was established in the Tang and later became part of the changing group of counties administered from Luanzhou. In 1267 the Yuan abolished Macheng County and incorporated it into Yifeng. Its name nevertheless survived in local records, including inscriptions collected in the Luanzhou gazetteer.
simp_chinese: 马城是滦州以南、滦河附近的旧县。唐代设县，后来成为滦州所辖诸县之一。元至元四年（1267年），马城县并入义丰，县名仍见于地方记录，包括《滦州志》所收的碑刻。

english: Macherla lies in the heart of Palnadu, a country remembered for a war between Macherla and Gurazala in the late twelfth century. The conflict is often called the Andhra Mahabharata. The town's Chennakesava temple dates from the rule of the Haihaya kings. Their minister Brahmanaidu is remembered for encouraging people of different castes to eat together, a practice known as Chapa Koodu.
simp_chinese: 马切尔拉位于帕尔纳德中心。这片地区因十二世纪末马切尔拉与古拉扎拉之间的战争而为人所铭记，战事常被称作“安得拉的摩诃婆罗多”。城中的琴纳凯沙瓦神庙建于海哈亚诸王统治时期。他们的大臣婆罗摩奈杜因倡导不同种姓的人同席进餐而为人所记，这一做法称为查帕·库杜。

english: The Machevna is a short river on the northeastern coast of Kamchatka, flowing into a lagoon of the same name on the Bering Sea. Its name is of Koryak origin. The river and the nearby bay interrupt a rugged coast backed by the mountains and tundra of the Koryak highlands. In the long northern winter, ice and snow cover much of this exposed landscape.
simp_chinese: 马切夫纳河是堪察加东北海岸的一条短河，注入白令海沿岸的同名潟湖。河名源自科里亚克语。河流与附近海湾切入崎岖海岸，背后是科里亚克高地的山地和苔原。漫长北方冬季里，冰雪覆盖这片暴露的土地。

english:
Machias lies on a river flowing into the coastal waters of eastern Maine. Its Passamaquoddy name has been translated as “bad little falls,” a reference to the rapids on the river. The falls later powered sawmills, and the surrounding forests supplied timber for the settlement and its maritime trade.

In 1633 Richard Vines established an English trading post near the river mouth, only for the French commander Charles de la Tour to attack it that same year. A more lasting settlement began in 1763, and sawmills were built at the falls in the following years. During the American Revolution, local settlers under Jeremiah O'Brien and Benjamin Foster captured the armed British schooner Margaretta in June 1775, in one of the war's earliest naval engagements.
simp_chinese:
马柴亚斯位于流入缅因东部沿海水域的一条河上。它的帕萨马科迪语名称被译为“险恶的小瀑布”，指的是河中的急流。瀑布后来为锯木场提供动力，周围的森林则为聚落及海上贸易提供木材。

1633年，理查德·瓦恩斯在河口附近建立英国贸易站，当年便遭法国指挥官夏尔·德拉图尔袭击。较为持久的殖民聚落始于1763年，随后数年，瀑布旁建起了锯木场。美国独立战争期间，当地移民在杰里迈亚·奥布赖恩和本杰明·福斯特带领下，于1775年6月俘获英国武装纵帆船“玛格丽塔”号，这是战争初期的一场海上交战。

english: The Machichi River crosses the low country south of Hudson Bay and flows northwest into its cold waters. The Hayes River enters the bay farther north, beside the mouth of the Nelson. At the Hayes estuary, York Factory became an important Hudson's Bay Company post, drawing the fur trade towards the coast while Cree hunters and travellers continued to use the rivers and wetlands of the surrounding country.
simp_chinese: 马奇奇河穿过哈得孙湾南岸的低地，向西北流入寒冷的海湾。更北方的海斯河则在纳尔逊河口旁注入海湾。海斯河河口的约克工厂成为哈得孙湾公司的重要据点，将毛皮贸易引向海岸；克里猎人与旅人则继续利用周围土地上的河流和湿地。

english: Lake Machisque lies in the forested country north of Pekuakami, or Lac Saint-Jean. Its waters feed the northeastern branch of the Mistassibi, which flows south towards the great lake. This interior forms part of the wider homeland of the Pekuakamiulnuatsh, whose journeys followed the rivers of the basin. During the fur trade, Ilnu hunters supplied trading posts while maintaining their relationships with the lakes and hunting grounds farther inland.
simp_chinese: 马奇斯克湖位于佩夸卡米，也就是圣让湖以北的森林地区。湖水汇入米斯塔西比河东北支流，向南流往大湖。这片内陆属于佩夸卡米乌尔努阿特什人更广阔的家园，他们沿流域河道往来。毛皮贸易时期，伊尔努猎人向商站供应皮毛，同时维持与更远内陆湖泊及猎场的联系。

english: Machul, also known as Bandar Mashur, lies near the head of Khor Musa on the northern Persian Gulf. The long tidal inlet penetrates the low, marshy coast of Khuzestan, offering sheltered waters behind the open gulf. The port appears in accounts of maritime traffic along the Persian coast, while the nearby waterways linked the coastal settlements with the riverlands around Dawraq and the Karun.
simp_chinese: 马丘尔又称班达尔马舒尔，位于波斯湾北部穆萨湾湾顶附近。狭长的潮汐水道深入胡齐斯坦低平的沼泽海岸，在开阔海湾后方提供庇护水域。波斯沿岸海上交通的记述中提到了这个港口，附近水道则将海滨聚落与杜拉格、卡伦河周围的河流地带连接起来。

english: Machynlleth is a market town in the valley of the River Dyfi, between the mountains of central Wales and the sea. Its market rights date from the late thirteenth century. In 1404, during his revolt against English rule, Owain Glyndŵr summoned representatives from across Wales to a parliament here. The assembly expressed his claim to govern an independent Wales and gave the small town a lasting place in Welsh political history.
simp_chinese: 马欣莱斯是迪菲河谷中的集镇，位于威尔士中部群山与大海之间。市场权利可追溯至十三世纪末。1404年，欧文·格林杜尔反抗英格兰统治期间，召集威尔士各地代表在此召开议会。这场集会表达了他治理独立威尔士的主张，也使这座小镇在威尔士政治史上占据持久地位。

english:
Macina is the great inland delta where the Niger and Bani spread into a maze of lakes, channels and seasonally flooded grasslands. Farmers, fishers and Fulbe cattle herders have long shared its resources, moving with the rise and fall of the waters. The floodplain joins the river towns of the western Sudan to pastures at the edge of the Sahel.

In the early nineteenth century the Muslim scholar Seku Amadu led a movement that established a new state in Macina. Its capital, Hamdullahi, was founded near the delta, and its rulers sought to order religious and political life under Islamic authority. Regulations governing access to pasture and the movement of livestock addressed the needs of the diverse communities who depended on the floodplain.
simp_chinese:
马西纳是尼日尔河的广大内陆三角洲，尼日尔河与巴尼河在此分为湖泊、水道和季节性淹没的草地。农民、渔民与富尔贝牧民长期共享这片资源，随着水位涨落而移动。洪泛平原将西苏丹的河畔城镇与萨赫勒边缘的牧场连接起来。

十九世纪初，穆斯林学者塞库·阿马杜领导一场运动，在马西纳建立新国家。首都哈姆达拉希建于三角洲附近，统治者试图以伊斯兰权威规范宗教与政治生活。有关牧场使用和牲畜迁徙的规定，则回应了依赖洪泛平原的不同社群的需要。

english: Mackay Lake lies amid the lakes and rocky barrens northeast of Great Slave Lake. Caribou travel through this country in spring and autumn, sometimes moving between Mackay Lake and Lac de Gras as the seasons change. At crossings between islands and shores, Dene hunters once pursued swimming caribou by canoe and speared them in the water. A place on Mackay Lake is remembered by the Yellowknives Dene as Tii Tseh’Go’o, “spear the water”, recalling such a hunt.
simp_chinese: 麦凯湖位于大奴湖东北方的湖泊与岩石荒原之间。驯鹿群在春秋两季经过这一带，随着季节变化往返于麦凯湖和格拉斯湖之间。过去，德内猎人乘独木舟在岛屿与湖岸间的渡口追赶游水的驯鹿，用矛刺杀。黄刀德内人将湖上一处地方称作提策戈，即“刺水”，这一名称保存了有关猎鹿的记忆。

sources.title: EA1314-01 17 Annex XVII Traditional Land Use and Traditional Knowledge Baseline.PDF

english: Wilkinkarra, or Lake Mackay, is a vast salt lake in the central Australian desert. Its shallow basin fills only after rain and dries to a wide expanse of salt crust. Gypsum islands rise above the lakebed, especially in its eastern part, while long sand dunes and clay pans extend across the surrounding country. Pintupi people know the lake as Wilkinkarra.
simp_chinese: 威尔金卡拉湖又称麦凯湖，是澳大利亚中部沙漠中的一座巨大盐湖。浅湖盆只有雨后才会积水，干涸时则露出广阔的盐壳。石膏岛屿高出湖床，尤以湖泊东部为多；漫长的沙丘与黏土洼地伸展在湖区周围。平图皮人称此湖为威尔金卡拉。

english: The Deh Cho, or Mackenzie River, flows north through a vast valley towards the Arctic Ocean. Its tributaries connect mountain hunting grounds with the lowlands and the delta. Dene and Gwich’in families travelled along these waterways to fish and hunt, gathering where rivers met. In 1789 Alexander Mackenzie descended the river; fur-trading posts followed in the early nineteenth century, joining an older network of exchange among northern peoples.
simp_chinese: 德乔河，即马更些河，向北流经广阔河谷，最终抵达北冰洋。支流将山地猎场与低地、三角洲联系起来。德内和哥威迅家庭沿水道往来捕鱼狩猎，在河流交汇处聚集。1789年，亚历山大·马更些沿河而下；19世纪初毛皮贸易站陆续出现，加入了北方各族已有的交换网络。

english: The Mackenzie Mountains form a long barrier between the Yukon interior and the valley of the great Deh Cho. Rivers rise on either side of their ranges, including the Pelly and the South Nahanni. The Mountain Dene travelled annual circuits through high passes, river valleys and forested lowlands, hunting caribou and moose and fishing along the way. Their knowledge of the mountains is preserved in place names and stories.
simp_chinese: 马更些山脉横亘育空内陆与大河德乔的河谷之间。佩利河、南纳汉尼河等河流发源于山脉两侧。山地德内人每年循着高山隘口、河谷和森林低地行走，沿途猎取驯鹿与驼鹿，也在水中捕鱼。他们对山地的认识保存在地名和故事里。

english: Forested uplands lie between the Mackenzie River and the northern shores of Great Bear Lake. Lakes and tributaries interrupt the low hills, forming part of the country through which Sahtu Dene families travelled to hunt and fish. Colville Lake to the north was known as K’áhbamítúé, “Ptarmigan Net Lake,” for the birds caught in the willows beside its water. Routes through the region linked such fishing places with the great Mackenzie valley.
simp_chinese: 马更些河与大熊湖北岸之间分布着森林高地。湖泊和支流切开低矮丘陵，萨图德内家庭穿行其间狩猎捕鱼。北方的科尔维尔湖被称为卡赫巴米图埃，即“雷鸟网湖”，得名于水边柳丛中捕捉的鸟类。区域内的道路将这样的渔场与马更些大河谷联系起来。

english: Munuscong Lake is a widening of the St Marys River, the waterway connecting Lake Superior with Lake Huron. Bordered by the wooded Upper Peninsula, Neebish Island and St Joseph Island, it shares the water level of Lake Huron. The Munuscong River flows into this broad reach, which drains southward through the DeTour Passage into the greater lake.
simp_chinese: 穆努斯孔湖是圣玛丽河展宽的一段水域；圣玛丽河连接苏必利尔湖与休伦湖。湖泊由森林覆盖的上半岛、尼比什岛和圣约瑟夫岛环抱，与休伦湖水位相同。穆努斯孔河流入这片宽阔水域，湖水再经德图尔水道向南流入休伦湖。

english: Macomer stands below the Campeda plateau in central-western Sardinia, in a district suited to grazing and the raising of cattle and horses. In 1478 forces of the Crown of Aragon defeated Leonardo Alagon, the last marquis of Oristano, near the town. The battle ended his resistance to Aragonese rule. In 1767 Macomer became the seat of the Marquisate of Marghine, which included several neighbouring villages.
simp_chinese: 马科梅尔坐落在撒丁岛中西部坎佩达高原下方，周围地区适合放牧和饲养牛马。1478年，阿拉贡王权的军队在镇附近击败奥里斯塔诺最后一位侯爵莱奥纳多·阿拉贡，结束了他对阿拉贡统治的抵抗。1767年，马科梅尔成为马尔吉内侯国的驻地，侯国还包括若干邻近村庄。

english:
Mâcon stands on the Saône, an important river town and bishop's seat at the southern edge of Burgundy. Its crossing and position on the route towards Lyon gave it importance to merchants and armies. The town and its county passed between the French crown and the dukes of Burgundy in the struggles of the fifteenth century.

The Treaty of Arras in 1435 gave Mâcon to Philip of Burgundy; it returned to France after the death of Charles the Bold in 1477. Religious war brought a new contest for the town. Protestant forces took Mâcon in 1562, but the Catholic royal governor Tavannes recovered it that August. Protestant worship was restored in 1564, only to be interrupted again when the town again changed hands in 1567.
simp_chinese:
马孔位于索恩河畔，是勃艮第南缘的河港和主教驻地。渡口及通往里昂的道路使它对商人和军队都有重要意义。十五世纪的争斗中，城镇与伯国在法国王室和勃艮第公爵之间易手。

1435年《阿拉斯条约》将马孔交给勃艮第的菲利普；1477年大胆查理死后，它回归法国。宗教战争使城镇再次成为争夺目标。新教军队于1562年夺取马孔，但天主教总督塔瓦讷在同年八月收复城市。1564年新教礼拜获准恢复，1567年城镇再次易手时又被中断。

english: Macoriges lies by the north coast of Cuba, close to the Bay of Santa Clara. The bay faces the Nicholas Channel, sheltered on its northern and western sides by the cays of the Sabana archipelago. To the south, wetlands fringe the Cuban shore, while the Cinco Leguas cays separate these waters from the neighbouring Bay of Cárdenas.
simp_chinese: 马科里赫斯位于古巴北岸，靠近圣克拉拉湾。海湾面向尼古拉斯海峡，北面与西面受到萨瓦纳群岛诸岛礁的遮蔽。南侧的古巴本岛岸边遍布湿地；西边的辛科莱瓜斯群礁将这片水域与邻近的卡德纳斯湾分隔开来。

english: Macoupin Creek winds southwest through the prairie and wooded valleys of the Illinois country, joining the Illinois River not far above its meeting with the Mississippi. The name is associated with a wild plant whose edible roots grew along local waterways. Illinois women gathered roots from the prairies as well as cultivating crops; in 1702 the French trader Pierre Delliette recorded a plant called macopine among the foods they valued.
simp_chinese: 马库平溪蜿蜒向西南流经伊利诺伊地区的草原与林地谷地，在伊利诺伊河汇入密西西比河不远的上游注入前者。名称与一种沿当地水道生长、根部可以食用的野生植物有关。伊利诺伊人的妇女除了种植作物，也在草原采集植物根茎；1702年，法国商人皮埃尔·德利耶特记载了他们喜爱的一种食物，称为马科平。

english:
Macquarie Island lies in the subantarctic ocean south of New Zealand. Cold, windy conditions and difficult landings distinguish it from the sheltered waters of many inhabited Pacific islands. It was not known as a permanent settlement before the nineteenth century; its recorded history in that period is tied to maritime voyages and sealing.

A sealing voyage recorded the island in 1810, after which Britain claimed it and sealers sought skins and oil there. Parties working ashore faced severe weather, difficult landings and dependence on visiting ships for supplies. Macquarie became part of a wider commercial expansion across subantarctic waters, where temporary camps were linked to distant markets by long and hazardous voyages.
simp_chinese:
麦夸里岛位于新西兰以南的亚南极海域，气候寒冷多风，登陆条件艰难。这里没有已知的十九世纪以前永久定居记录；这一时期的记载主要与海上航行和猎海豹有关。

1810年，一次猎海豹航行记录了这座岛，英国随后宣称拥有它，猎人也来此获取海豹皮和油脂。上岸的人员面临恶劣天气和困难的登陆条件，并依靠来往船只补给。麦夸里岛由此成为亚南极海域商业扩张的一部分，临时营地通过漫长而危险的航程与远方市场相连。

english: Macquarie Heads marks the narrow entrance to Macquarie Harbour on Tasmania’s exposed western coast. A difficult passage leads between the open Southern Ocean and the sheltered waters within. In the early nineteenth century European navigators entered the harbour, while the surrounding coast and forests had long formed part of Aboriginal country.
simp_chinese: 麦夸里角标示塔斯马尼亚无遮蔽西岸麦夸里港的狭窄入口。一条难行水道连接开阔南大洋与港内受庇护水域。十九世纪初，欧洲航海者进入海港；周围海岸和森林此前长期属于原住民土地。

english:
Macuxi refers to the Macushi country between the headwaters of the Branco and Rupununi rivers in the Guiana interior. Its southern savannas meet more densely wooded uplands to the north. Cariban-speaking communities occupied villages and smaller settlements connected by paths, with family relationships extending across the boundaries separating neighbouring peoples. Bitter cassava supplied bread, flour and drinks, while hunting, fishing and shifting cultivation supported village life.

Portuguese expansion into the Branco valley in the eighteenth century brought military posts and attempts to concentrate Indigenous inhabitants in mission villages. In 1775 the Portuguese built Fort São Joaquim where the Uraricoera and Tacutu meet, seeking to secure approaches toward Spanish and Dutch territories. Macuxi participation in the mission settlements remained limited. Two chiefs, Ananahy in 1784 and Paraujamari in 1788, brought small groups, but their stays were brief. In 1790 Paraujamari was accused of leading a rebellion during which most settled inhabitants fled. These encounters reveal an inland society whose leaders and families continued to make their own decisions amid expanding colonial demands.

The later city of Boa Vista lies here.
simp_chinese:
马库西指圭亚那内陆布朗库河与鲁普努尼河源流之间的马库西人地域，南部草原同北面林木更密的高地相接。使用加勒比语族语言的社群居住在村落和小聚落中，通过小径互通，家庭关系也跨越邻近族群的边界。苦木薯加工成面饼、粉食和饮料，狩猎、捕鱼与迁移耕作共同支持村落生活。

十八世纪，葡萄牙向布朗库河谷扩张，设置军事据点，并试图将原住民集中到传教村。1775年，他们在乌拉里科埃拉河与塔库图河汇流处修建圣若阿金堡，以控制通向西班牙和荷兰势力范围的道路。加入传教村的马库西人却很少。阿纳纳希于1784年、帕劳雅马里于1788年分别率小群体迁入，停留都不长。1790年，殖民者指控帕劳雅马里领导叛乱，期间多数集中居住者逃离。这些相遇显示，面对逐步增加的殖民要求，内陆社群的首领与家庭仍在自主决定去留。

后来的博阿维斯塔即位于此地。

english: Macuze lies near a river mouth on the low coast of central Mozambique, northeast of Quelimane. The coastal plain is crossed by waterways and tidal channels, with mangroves bordering the meeting of river and sea. Communities along this shore combined fishing and cultivation, while boats could use the estuaries to reach settlements among the rivers of the Zambezi coast.
simp_chinese: 马库泽位于莫桑比克中部低平海岸的河口附近，在克利马内东北方。海岸平原布满河道与潮汐水道，红树林环绕河海交汇之处。沿岸社群结合渔业与耕作，船只可利用河口进入赞比西海岸各河流之间的聚落。

english: Madaba stands on a fertile plateau east of the Dead Sea. A bishopric in late antiquity, the town was adorned with churches whose floors carried elaborate mosaics. One pavement depicts the Holy Land, including a detailed view of Jerusalem, with gates, streets and churches picked out in coloured stone. Madaba continued to prosper after the early Islamic conquest, although an earthquake and later changes in settlement left many of its buildings in ruins.
simp_chinese: 马达巴位于死海以东的肥沃高原。古代晚期这里是主教驻地，教堂地面铺有精美的镶嵌画。其中一幅描绘圣地的地图细致呈现耶路撒冷，以彩色石块勾勒城门、街道和教堂。早期伊斯兰征服之后，马达巴仍然繁荣，但地震和后来的聚落变迁使许多建筑逐渐成为废墟。

english:
Madakalapu, or Batticaloa, lies beside a long lagoon on Sri Lanka’s eastern coast. Its sheltered waters and routes inland made it an important outlet for the kingdom of Kandy, which sought access to the sea while Portuguese forces occupied much of the western coast. Rice, areca nuts and elephants were among the products of the surrounding country.

In 1628 the Portuguese commander Constantino de Sá built a fort on Puliyantivu island in the lagoon. Kandy opposed the loss of this important port. In 1638 Dutch forces attacked and captured the fort in cooperation with the Kandyan king. The Dutch later withdrew and returned, seeking to control trade and collect revenues from the area. The fort’s lagoon setting gave it natural protection and made it a contested gateway between the island’s interior and the Indian Ocean.
simp_chinese:
马达卡拉普即拜蒂克洛，位于斯里兰卡东岸一条长潟湖旁。受庇护的水域和通往内陆的道路使它成为康提王国的重要出海口；当时葡萄牙军队占据了西海岸大部。周围地区出产稻米、槟榔，也提供大象。

1628年，葡萄牙指挥官康斯坦蒂诺·德·萨在潟湖中的普利扬提武岛修建堡垒。康提反对失去这一重要港口。1638年，荷兰军队与康提国王合作攻占堡垒。荷兰人后来撤离又返回，试图控制贸易并征收当地收入。潟湖地形为堡垒提供天然保护，也使它成为岛屿内陆与印度洋之间备受争夺的门户。

english: Madanda lies north of the Save in a region of dry forest growing on sandy ground. Dense shrubs stand beneath trees such as baobab and afzelia, giving the woodland a character of its own. The name also belonged to the country of Danda, a Shona-speaking polity south of the Teve kingdom. In the early sixteenth century the ruler of Teve sent his son Nyamunda to conquer Danda, where he established a ruling line known by the title Sedanda.
simp_chinese: 马丹达位于萨韦河以北，干燥的森林生长在沙地上。猴面包树和非洲红花梨等乔木之下，灌木丛生，使这片林地别具特色。马丹达也是丹达地区的名称，那里曾有讲绍纳语的政权，位于特韦王国以南。16世纪初，特韦统治者派儿子尼亚蒙达征服丹达，并在那里建立以塞丹达为称号的统治家族。

english:
Madaran was a fortified place on the south-western frontier of the Bengal Sultanate, close to the contested approaches to Odisha. Its strategic importance lay in its position between the two kingdoms. The remains of the inner fort are associated with the tomb of Shah Ismail Ghazi, a figure remembered in local accounts of warfare along the frontier.

The early sixteenth century brought renewed fighting between Sultan Husain Shah of Bengal and Prataparudra of Odisha. An Odishan chronicle recounts an invasion in 1509 and the retreat of the Bengal forces to the fortress of Madaran, where they were besieged. Accounts differ over the details of Ismail Ghazi’s life and death, but his name remained attached to the fort and to stories of the struggles that made this frontier a military outpost.
simp_chinese:
马达兰是孟加拉苏丹国西南边疆的一处要塞，靠近通往奥里萨的争夺地带。它处于两个王国之间，因而具有军事意义。内堡遗址与沙阿·伊斯梅尔·加齐之墓相联系，地方传说记住了他参与边疆战争的故事。

十六世纪初，孟加拉苏丹侯赛因沙与奥里萨的普拉塔帕鲁德拉之间再起战事。一部奥里萨编年史记载了1509年的入侵，以及孟加拉军退守马达兰并遭围攻的经过。有关伊斯梅尔·加齐生平和死因的记载并不一致，但他的名字仍与这座堡垒及两国边境的战争故事相连。

sources.title: 1917 Journal & Proceedings of Asiatic Society of Bengal Vol 13 NS s.pdf

english: Madas lies on the dry high plains near Bir el Ater, north of the Négrine plateau. Steppe vegetation includes alfa grass and wormwood, with patches of juniper on uncultivated ground. The high country forms a transition between the plains around Tébessa and the Saharan lands farther south.
simp_chinese: 马达斯位于比尔阿泰尔附近的干燥高平原，在内格里讷高原以北。草原植被包括针茅和蒿草，未耕地上还散布着杜松。这片高地处在特贝萨周围平原与更南方撒哈拉地区之间的过渡地带。

english: Madaun lies in the valley of the Magadaven, among the mountains inland from the northern Sea of Okhotsk. Its name preserves the Even name associated with the river. Forested slopes and streams cut through the highlands, dividing waters that flow toward the coast from those of the Kolyma basin farther north. Winter ice and snow cover this inland landscape for much of the year.
simp_chinese: 马达翁位于马加达文河谷，地处鄂霍次克海北岸内陆的山地。地名保留了与河流有关的埃文语名称。森林山坡与溪流切割高地，分隔流向海岸的水流和更北方的科雷马河流域。一年大部分时间，冬季冰雪覆盖这片内陆景观。

english:
Madawaska lies where the river of that name joins the upper Wolastoq, the Saint John River. The Wolastoqiyik, or people of the river, lived in this forested valley and travelled north by Lake Témiscouata and the portages leading toward the Saint Lawrence. Their homeland connected the great river's upper waters with the lands farther downstream.

In the 1780s Acadian families moved upriver from the Fredericton area, where the arrival of Loyalists had added pressure on land. French Canadians joined them, and farms spread along both banks of the upper river and its tributaries. The valley lay within territory claimed by both Britain and the United States after the Treaty of Paris in 1783. By 1831 the Madawaska settlements stretched for many miles along the river, while the boundary remained disputed.
simp_chinese:
马达瓦斯卡位于同名河流与沃拉斯托克，也就是圣约翰河上游的汇流处。沃拉斯托基伊克人，即“河流之民”，生活在这片森林河谷中，并沿蒂米斯卡明湖和陆上转运路向北前往圣劳伦斯河。他们的家园将大河上游与更下游的土地连接起来。

十八世纪八十年代，阿卡迪亚家庭从弗雷德里克顿附近沿河上迁，那里因保皇派移民到来而面临更大的土地压力。法裔加拿大人也加入他们，农场沿大河两岸及支流逐渐展开。1783年《巴黎条约》签订后，英国和美国都声称这片河谷属于自己。到1831年，马达瓦斯卡聚落已沿河延伸许多英里，边界仍未确定。

english: Maddela lies in the upper Cagayan basin of northern Luzon, where the river passes the foothills of the Sierra Madre. The forests and valleys were home to Ilongot and Dumagat communities, who hunted in the hills and fished along the river. In the eighteenth century Agta people occupied lands east of the Cagayan toward the Pacific, moving through a landscape of wooded ridges and waterways. The river provided a path through this rugged interior.
simp_chinese: 马德拉位于吕宋北部卡加延河上游流域，河流从马德雷山麓经过。森林与河谷是伊隆戈特和杜马加特社群的家园，他们在山中狩猎，在河中捕鱼。十八世纪，阿格塔人居住在卡加延河以东、通向太平洋的土地上，往来于林木覆盖的山脊与水道之间。河流为穿越这片崎岖内陆提供了通路。

english:
The Madeira is one of the great tributaries of the Amazon, carrying water from the southern basin north through tropical forest. Rapids interrupt its upper course, while farther downstream the river broadens and flows toward its junction with the Amazon. Its seasonal floods reach into the surrounding lowlands, where channels and flooded forest form part of an immense and changing waterscape.

The later city of Puerto Maldonado lies here.
simp_chinese:
马德拉河是亚马孙河的大支流之一，将南方流域的水带过热带森林，向北注入亚马孙河。上游的急流阻断了部分河道，下游则渐渐开阔，通向与亚马孙河的汇合处。季节性洪水漫入周围低地，河道与被淹没的森林共同构成一片辽阔而不断变化的水泽。

后来的马尔多纳多港即位于此地。

english:
Madembe lies near Sibiti, on a plateau south of the Chaillu massif. East of Sibiti, rounded hills extend toward Mount Ndoumu and the Bouenza River; farther southwest the plateau grades into the Niari plain. The high ridge above the plateau forms part of the watershed between the Ogooué and Niari basins.

The later city of Sibiti lies here.
simp_chinese:
马登贝位于西比提附近、沙伊山地以南的高原上。西比提以东，圆缓丘陵向恩杜穆山和布恩扎河延伸；再往西南，高原逐渐过渡到尼亚里平原。高原上方的山脊构成奥果韦河与尼亚里河流域之间的分水岭之一。

后来的锡比提即位于此地。

english: Maden is a Papuan language of western New Guinea’s Bird’s Head Peninsula. Its speakers inhabit a region of forested hills and coastal waterways near the western end of the peninsula. Many distinct languages are spoken across this landscape, where islands and mainland shores face the seas leading west towards Raja Ampat.
simp_chinese: 马登语是新几内亚西部鸟头半岛的一种巴布亚语言。使用者居住在半岛西端附近的森林山丘和沿岸水道地区。这里分布着许多不同语言，岛屿与大陆海岸面向向西通往拉贾安帕特的海域。

english: Madgaon, or Margao, lies beside the Sal River in the country of Salcete. The town grew around its parish church and the open space before it, a setting shaped by Portuguese rule in Goa. The Jesuits founded the Church of the Holy Spirit in 1564–65, soon after establishing themselves in Salcete. Its early history was troubled: a Bijapuri raid set it on fire in 1571, and another attack damaged it in 1579. The church was rebuilt between 1585 and 1595, enlarged in 1604 and replaced again in the seventeenth century.
simp_chinese: 马德冈又称马尔冈，位于萨尔塞特地区的萨尔河畔。城镇围绕堂区教堂及其前方的广场发展，其面貌受到葡萄牙在果阿统治的影响。耶稣会士在萨尔塞特立足不久，于1564至1565年建立圣神教堂。教堂早年历经波折：1571年比贾布尔军队的袭击使它遭到火焚，1579年另一次袭击又造成损坏。教堂于1585至1595年重建，1604年扩建，十七世纪又被新的建筑取代。

english:
Madhubani belongs to the heart of Mithila, near the seats of rulers whose courts sustained Sanskrit learning and Maithili literary culture. The Oinwar dynasty governed this country during the later Middle Ages. Its rulers shifted their capital to Sugauna near Madhubani when Bengal's intervention divided Tirhut, placing the locality close to an important political centre rather than making it the capital itself.

The wider country subsequently entered the Mughal provincial system. Authority changed again after the British victory at Buxar in 1764, when Madhubani and other parts of Bihar passed under British control. Administrators faced both local resistance and incursions across the Nepal frontier. The resulting conflict formed part of the Anglo-Nepalese War of the early nineteenth century. Madhubani's historical setting thus joins Mithila's courtly traditions with successive provincial governments and the pressures of a northern frontier, whose political relationships extended beyond the boundaries of the present district.
simp_chinese:
默图伯尼位于弥萨罗的核心地域，附近统治者的宫廷支持梵文学术与迈蒂利文学。中世纪后期，奥因瓦尔王朝治理这一带。孟加拉势力介入、提鲁特被分为两部后，王朝将都城迁至默图伯尼附近的苏高纳，使这里接近重要政治中心；都城本身并非默图伯尼。

较大地域随后进入莫卧儿省级体系。1764年英国在布克萨尔获胜后，默图伯尼与比哈尔其他地区又转入英国控制。行政当局既面对地方反抗，也应对尼泊尔边境的侵入，相关矛盾成为十九世纪初英尼战争背景的一部分。这里的历史环境因而连接弥萨罗的宫廷传统、接续的省级政府与北部边境压力，其政治关系延伸至今日县界之外。

english: The Ma'di inhabit country around the upper Nile and the lands to its west, where woodland and river valleys give way to open fields. They speak a Central Sudanic language and have traditionally relied on cultivation. Communities near the river live in a landscape shaped by seasonal rain and the flow of the Nile. Their homeland forms part of the wider mosaic of peoples of the southern Nile basin.
simp_chinese: 马迪人居住在尼罗河上游及其西侧地区，林地和河谷之间分布着开阔田地。他们说中苏丹语族的语言，传统上以耕作为生。河流附近的社群生活在受季节降雨和尼罗河水流塑造的土地上。他们的家园是尼罗河流域南部多样族群地区的一部分。

english: Madi Madi, also known as Muthi Muthi, country lies among the rivers and plains of southwestern New South Wales. Neighbouring Aboriginal peoples included the Kureinji, Dadi Dadi, Nari Nari and Yitha Yitha. River channels and floodplains connected these communities across a landscape that changed with the seasonal movement of water.
simp_chinese: 马迪马迪又称穆蒂穆蒂，其土地位于新南威尔士西南部的河流与平原之间。原住民邻居包括库伦吉、达迪达迪、纳里纳里和伊塔伊塔人。河道与泛滥平原将这些社群相连，景观随水流的季节性变化而改变。

english: Mǎdǐ was a post station in the mountains east of Yuánlíng. Its name was linked to the shape of the surrounding hills, said to resemble a horse lowering its neck to drink from the Yí Stream. The Ming established a station here on the route through western Hunan. A Qing county gazetteer lists its offices alongside the nearby stations at Chényáng and Jiètíng, and records orders against burdensome unofficial levies imposed on the post service.
simp_chinese: 马底是沅陵以东山地中的驿站。当地四面环山，山势相传如马颈伸向怡溪饮水，因此得名。明代在此设驿，成为湘西道路上的一站。清代《沅陵县志》将马底驿与辰阳、界亭等驿并列，又记载官府曾下令禁止借驿站名义加派差役，以减轻民间负担。

english: Madila lies near Ouled Rechache, east of Khenchela in the Nemencha country. The Nemencha mountains extend between Khenchela and Tébessa, their western edge separated from the Aurès by the Mellagou, also known as Oued el Arab. The region has long been associated with the Nemencha, a confederation of Chaoui-speaking pastoral tribes.
simp_chinese: 马迪拉位于亨舍拉以东、乌莱德雷沙什附近的奈曼沙地区。奈曼沙山地横亘于亨舍拉和特贝萨之间，西缘以梅拉古河，即阿拉伯河，与奥雷斯山地相隔。这一地区长期与奈曼沙人相关，他们是讲肖维语的牧业部族联盟。

english:
Ma'din Bani Sulaym, the mine of the Bani Sulaym, lies in the uplands southeast of Medina. Its gold-bearing rocks made it one of Arabia's most celebrated mining districts. The Iraqi pilgrimage road passed nearby, joining the settlement to a chain of wells and stations across the Hejaz. Ancient workings, ore waste and remains of buildings mark the long history of mining at the place later known as Mahd al-Dhahab, the cradle of gold.

The mine was worked by the Bani Sulaym in the early Islamic period and received particular attention under the Umayyads and Abbasids. Early historians record officials appointed to oversee it, and Kufic inscriptions found among the old mining waste belong to the Abbasid era. Gold and silver from the district contributed to the economy of the caliphate, while the nearby pilgrimage route brought travellers through the mining country on their way to Mecca.
simp_chinese:
巴尼苏莱姆矿区位于麦地那东南的高地。含金岩石使这里成为阿拉伯最著名的矿区之一。伊拉克朝觐道路从附近经过，将聚落与遍布汉志的水井和驿站联系起来。古代矿坑、矿渣和建筑遗迹见证了此地漫长的采矿历史；它后来被称为迈赫德宰海卜，即“黄金的摇篮”。

伊斯兰早期，巴尼苏莱姆人在这里开采矿产；倭马亚和阿拔斯时期，矿区尤其受到重视。早期史家记载了被任命管理矿区的官员，旧矿渣中发现的库法体铭文属于阿拔斯时代。当地的金银为哈里发国经济作出贡献，附近的朝觐道路也使前往麦加的旅人经过矿区。

english: The village of the Alids lay in the country around Tlemcen, on a route described by medieval Arab geographers. Ibn Hawqal called it a large inhabited village beside a river, with gardens and springs. Its name recalled the Alid rulers who had held authority in the region. The old accounts place it near the approaches to Tlemcen, a city that later became the capital of the Zayyanid kingdom and a major centre of learning and trade.
simp_chinese: 阿里后裔村位于特莱姆森周边地区，处在中古阿拉伯地理学家记述的道路上。伊本·豪盖勒称它是一座人口众多的大村，临河而建，有园圃和泉水。村名令人想起曾统治这一地区的阿里后裔。古代记述将它置于特莱姆森的通道附近；这座城市后来成为宰扬王国的首都，也是重要的学术和贸易中心。

english: Madinat al-Far stood east of the Balikh River, on the road between Raqqa and Edessa. A canal brought water from the river to the town, whose square walls enclosed an area some 320 metres on each side. Towers strengthened its defences, and settlement extended beyond the southern wall in the Abbasid period. Founded or occupied in Umayyad times, the town lay at a junction of routes joining Mesopotamia, the Jazira and Anatolia.
simp_chinese: 法尔城位于巴利赫河以东、拉卡与埃德萨之间的道路上。一条运河从河中引水至城内；城墙围成方形，每边约三百二十米，并有塔楼加强防御。城镇在倭马亚时期已有居民，阿拔斯时期的聚落向南墙之外扩展。这里处于美索不达米亚、杰济拉与安纳托利亚道路的交汇地带。

english: Madjul lies near the Gammouda plain of central Tunisia, west of the Regueb country. The seasonal Oued El Fekka crosses the Sidi Bouzid plain and joins a wider network draining towards the Zeroud. Farmers have long diverted floodwater from the Fekka and its tributary El Hachim onto fields along the valley.
simp_chinese: 马朱勒位于突尼斯中部加穆达平原附近，在雷盖布地区以西。季节性的费卡河穿过西迪布济德平原，汇入流向宰鲁德河的水系。农人长期将费卡河及其支流哈希姆河的洪水引向沿谷田地。

english: Madoi lies high in the source country of the Yellow River, north of the Bayan Har Mountains. Streams cross the alpine plateau and flow through the great freshwater lakes of Gyaring and Ngoring before the river turns east. The climate is severe, with long, dry winters and a brief cool summer when most rain falls. Grasslands and wetlands support pastoral life in this lofty region.
simp_chinese: 玛多位于巴颜喀拉山以北、黄河源头的高寒地区。溪流穿越高原，流经扎陵湖和鄂陵湖两座大型淡水湖，河水随后转向东方。这里气候严酷，冬季漫长干燥，夏季短暂凉爽，一年中大部分雨水集中在夏季。草地和湿地维系着高原牧业生活。

english:
Madras grew on the Coromandel Coast around Fort St George, the trading post founded by the English East India Company in the seventeenth century. The coast offered access to cotton textiles woven in the Tamil hinterland and shipped across the Indian Ocean. Indian merchants, artisans and labourers settled around the fort, building a town whose fortunes were closely tied to commerce.

In 1639 Company agents obtained a grant of land from a local Nayak, and construction of the fort began the following year. The English settlement expanded as merchants and weavers came to serve its trade. In 1746, during war between Britain and France, French forces captured Madras; it was restored to the British under the peace settlement of 1748. The town subsequently served as a base for British operations during the Carnatic wars and the struggles with Mysore. By the early nineteenth century it was the seat of the Company’s government over a large part of southern India, while older settlements and temples remained woven into its expanding urban landscape.
simp_chinese:
马德拉斯在科罗曼德海岸的圣乔治堡周围发展起来。英国东印度公司于十七世纪建立这座贸易据点，利用沿海位置取得泰米尔内陆织造的棉布，再运往印度洋各地。印度商人、工匠和劳工在堡垒附近定居，形成一座命运与商业紧密相连的城镇。

1639年，公司代理人从当地纳亚克处取得土地，次年开始修筑堡垒。商人和织工陆续前来，英国聚落随贸易扩张。1746年英法交战期间，法国军队攻占马德拉斯；1748年和约将它归还英国。此后，城镇成为英国在卡纳提克战争及与迈索尔斗争中的行动基地。十九世纪初，这里已是东印度公司统治南印度大片领土的行政驻地，而较古老的聚落和神庙仍融入不断扩大的城市景观。

english: Laguna Madre is a long, shallow coastal lagoon on the Tamaulipas shore of the Gulf of Mexico. Barrier islands and sand spits separate its waters from the open sea, while the mainland lies to the west. High evaporation and limited exchange with fresh water make much of the lagoon unusually salty. Its flats and sheltered waters form part of the extensive coastal landscape south of the Rio Grande.
simp_chinese: 马德雷潟湖是墨西哥湾塔毛利帕斯海岸上一片狭长的浅潟湖。沙障岛与沙嘴将湖水同外海分开，西面则是大陆。强烈蒸发和有限的淡水交换使潟湖许多地方的盐度格外高。浅滩与受庇护的水域构成格兰德河以南广阔海岸景观的一部分。

english: The Sierra Madre Occidental rises between the coastal plain of Sinaloa and the high interior of northern Mexico. Deep ravines cut its western slopes, carrying rivers toward the Gulf of California, while pine and oak forests cover much of the higher country. The mountains were home to Indigenous peoples including the Acaxee, Xixime and Tepehuan, whose communities occupied different valleys and uplands. Spanish mining and missionary expansion reached the sierra during the colonial period. In 1601 Acaxee communities rose against Spanish authority in the mountains around Topia and San Andrés. A larger Tepehuan uprising followed in 1616, and Spanish forces fought for years to restore control over parts of the region.
simp_chinese: 西马德雷山脉耸立在锡那罗亚沿海平原与墨西哥北部内陆高地之间。深谷切入西坡，河流流向加利福尼亚湾；较高的地带多覆有松橡林。这里是阿卡希人、希希梅人和特佩瓦人等原住民的家园，不同社区分布在山谷与高地。 殖民时期，西班牙采矿和传教活动进入山区。1601年，托皮亚与圣安德烈斯周围山区的阿卡希社区起义反抗西班牙统治。1616年又爆发规模更大的特佩瓦起义，西班牙军队经过多年战斗才恢复对部分地区的控制。

sources.title: El día que el mesías Diego anunció el Apocalipsis  en el Cerro Azul .pdf

english:
Founded in the late 9th century as the small Muslim outpost of #italic Majrīṭ#!, taking its name from the abundant springs that watered its surrounding heaths, Madrid was a fortified rural town of the Caliphate's northern frontier when Alfonso VI of León-Castile captured it without resistance in 1083 during his great advance toward Toledo. The Castilian crown maintained it as a modest royal town, granting it its #italic Fuero#! in 1202 under Alfonso VIII, and the moors of its hunting grounds made it a favored stopping place for the itinerant Castilian court. In 1309 King Ferdinand IV convened the Cortes of Castile at Madrid for the first time, a sign of the town's growing administrative importance even as it remained a modest settlement in the long shadow of the nearby imperial city of Toledo.

The Cortes met in Madrid again in 1329, 1339 and 1391, yet it stayed a middling town, better known for its long quarrel with Segovia over the lands of the Real de Manzanares. In 1520 it joined the Comunero revolt against Charles V and was occupied by imperial troops after the rebel defeat at Villalar. Its fortune turned in June 1561, when Philip II settled his court in the old alcázar. A town of some 18,000 people swelled to about 80,000 by 1598, crowded with courtiers, discharged soldiers and foreigners, and hunger and high prices came with them. When the court left for Valladolid in 1601 the streets emptied; its return in 1606 brought back nobles, diplomats, writers and painters, and the playhouses flourished while the poorest stayed desperately poor. The Bourbons at last gave Madrid the look of a capital: Philip V raised the Royal Palace, and Charles III gave its streets sewers and lamps.
simp_chinese:
马德里建于9世纪末，最初是一个名为#italic 马伊里特#!的小型穆斯林前哨，得名于滋润周边荒野的丰富泉水。当莱昂‑卡斯蒂利亚的阿方索六世在1083年向托莱多大举推进时，马德里作为哈里发北部边境的一座设防乡村城镇被他不战而取。卡斯蒂利亚王室将它维持为一座不大的王室城镇，在阿方索八世治下于1202年授予它#italic 特许状#!，其猎场上的摩尔人也使它成为巡游的卡斯蒂利亚宫廷喜爱的驻留之地。1309年，费迪南德四世首次在马德里召集卡斯蒂利亚议会，这标志着该镇日益增长的行政重要性，尽管它仍然是附近帝国城市托莱多阴影下的一个不大的定居点。

1329年、1339年和1391年，卡斯蒂利亚议会又先后在马德里召开，但它仍是一座中等城镇，出名的不过是与塞戈维亚为曼萨纳雷斯王领的归属长年相争。1520年，马德里加入反对查理五世的公社起义，起义军在比利亚拉尔战败后，城市被帝国军队占领。命运的转折出现在1561年6月，腓力二世把宫廷安置在旧王宫里。约1.8万人的小城，到1598年膨胀到8万左右，挤满了廷臣、退伍士兵和外国人，饥荒和高物价也随之而来。1601年宫廷迁往巴利亚多利德，街道一下子冷清了；1606年宫廷回归，贵族、外交官、作家和画家重又云集，剧场盛极一时，最穷的人却始终穷困不堪。直到波旁王朝，马德里才有了都城的样子：腓力五世兴建了王宫，卡洛斯三世为街道修了下水道、点起了街灯。

english: Sierra Madrona forms part of the rugged mountain country on the southern edge of La Mancha. Its wooded ridges and valleys contain traces of people who lived here thousands of years ago. At Peña Escrita near Fuencaliente, figures painted on rock shelters depict humans, animals and signs in a schematic style. Dating from the Copper and Bronze Ages, these paintings preserve an ancient record of life in the mountains long before the kingdoms of medieval Iberia.
simp_chinese: 马德罗纳山脉是拉曼恰南缘崎岖山区的一部分，森林覆盖的山脊和谷地保留着数千年前人类活动的痕迹。丰卡连特附近的佩尼亚埃斯克里塔岩棚上，以简练风格绘有人物、动物和符号。这些绘画可追溯至铜石并用时代和青铜时代，记录了中世纪伊比利亚诸王国出现之前久远的山地生活。

english:
Madugula, once called Vaddadi or Vaddadimadugula, was a seat of the Matsya dynasty, the southernmost vassals of the Eastern Ganga kings of Kalinga. Copperplate grants preserve the names of its rulers and their gifts: Jayanta Raju donated two villages to the temple at Simhachalam. The records reveal a dynasty whose ties reached across the hills to neighbouring courts and sacred places.

In the fourteenth century Veer Arjuna Deva allied with the Reddy chiefs in an unsuccessful attempt to escape Ganga overlordship. Inscriptions of 1427 record the marriage of Singamma, daughter of Jayanta Deva Raju II, to Vishwanath Raj of Nandapur. The Matsya ruler Singharaju later helped Vinayak Dev recover the neighbouring throne from rival claimants. After the Gajapati Empire weakened in the sixteenth century, Madugula became subordinate to Nandapur and later Jeypore.
simp_chinese:
马杜古拉旧称瓦达迪或瓦达迪马杜古拉，是末蹉王朝的驻地；该王朝是羯陵伽东恒伽诸王最南端的属臣。铜版赐地文书保存了统治者的名字和捐赠：贾扬塔·拉朱曾向辛哈查拉姆神庙捐出两个村庄。这些记录展现了山地王朝与邻近宫廷、宗教圣地的联系。

十四世纪，维拉·阿尔朱纳·德瓦与雷迪首领结盟，试图摆脱恒伽宗主权，却未能成功。1427年的铭文记载，贾扬塔·德瓦·拉朱二世之女辛伽玛嫁给南达普尔的维什瓦纳特·拉杰。末蹉统治者辛伽拉朱后来帮助维纳亚克·德瓦从竞争者手中收复邻国王位。十六世纪伽阇波底帝国衰落后，马杜古拉先后臣属于南达普尔与杰伊普尔。

english:
Maduna is a ruined medieval settlement in the hills of northern Somalia. Its most prominent building is a rectangular mosque, whose stone walls preserve a mihrab indicating the direction of prayer. The remains of houses surround the mosque, revealing a community with an established Islamic centre. Unlike some ruined towns farther west, Maduna includes circular houses, adding to the variety of settlement forms found across the northern Horn of Africa.

The later city of Las Anod lies here.
simp_chinese:
马杜纳是索马里北部山地中的中世纪聚落遗址。最醒目的建筑是一座长方形清真寺，石墙上仍保留着指示礼拜方向的壁龛。清真寺周围散布着民居遗迹，显示这里曾有以伊斯兰教建筑为中心的社群。与西方某些废弃城镇不同，马杜纳还有圆形房屋，为非洲之角北部多样的聚落形式增添了一例。

后来的拉斯阿诺德即位于此地。

english: The Madura Strait separates eastern Java from Madura Island, connecting the Java Sea with waters farther east. Surabaya stands on the Javanese shore near its western entrance, where the strait narrows between the two islands. Fishing and salt-making have long been important along these coasts, while the sheltered passage gave ships access to the ports of eastern Java.
simp_chinese: 马都拉海峡将爪哇东部与马都拉岛分开，连接爪哇海和更东面的水域。泗水位于爪哇一岸，靠近海峡西侧入口，两岛在此距离较近。沿岸捕鱼和制盐长期占有重要地位，这条较为隐蔽的水道也让船只得以驶向爪哇东部港口。

english:
For more than a thousand years Madurai has been the capital of the Pandya kings of the Tamil south, a city whose great temple to the goddess Meenakshi crowned a civilization of poets, scholars, and warrior-aristocrats. The Tamil literary academies, the #italic Sangam#!, were said to have flourished here in antiquity, drawing the bards of the southern courts to debate and refine the language. Malik Kafur, the great general of Alauddin Khalji of Delhi, stormed the city in 1311 and carried off its accumulated treasure, and in 1335 the Tughluq governor Jalāl ad-Dīn Ḥasan proclaimed the independent Madurai Sultanate, a fragile Muslim power planted in the ancient Tamil heartland.

The sultanate did not last half a century. Ibn Battuta, who married into its ruling family, left a grim portrait of the sultan Ghiyāth ad-Dīn Damghani, who in 1343 had the captured Hoysala king Ballala III put to death and his stuffed body hung on the walls of Madurai. In the 1370s Kumara Kampana of Vijayanagara overthrew the last sultan, and a Sanskrit poem by his wife tells how he reopened the Meenakshi temple and brought back the images that had been hidden through the Muslim years.

Under the Nayaks, first sent as Vijayanagara's governors in 1529, Madurai became a royal capital again. They walled and widened the temple, crowding it with gateway towers and pillared halls, and Tirumala Nayak, the greatest of the line, brought the court back from Tiruchirappalli and raised a vast palace in the city. The dynasty ended in 1736, when Chanda Sahib, acting for the Nawab of Arcot, took its last ruler, Queen Meenakshi, prisoner.
simp_chinese:
一千多年来，马杜赖一直是南泰米尔潘地亚国王们的都城，这座以米纳克希女神的大寺庙为中心的城市，孕育了诗人、学者和武士贵族组成的文明。据说，古代的泰米尔文学院#italic 桑伽姆#!曾在此繁荣兴盛，吸引南方各宫廷的吟游诗人前来论辩和锤炼语言。1311年，德里苏丹阿拉丁·哈尔吉麾下大将马利克·卡富尔攻陷该城，掠走了积存的财富；1335年，图格鲁克总督贾拉勒丁·哈桑宣布建立独立的马杜赖苏丹国——一个根植于古老泰米尔腹地的脆弱穆斯林政权。

这个苏丹国没撑过半个世纪。伊本·白图泰娶了王族的女子，他笔下的苏丹吉亚斯丁·达姆加尼凶残异常：1343年，达姆加尼处死被俘的霍伊萨拉国王巴拉拉三世，把填塞过的尸身挂上马杜赖城墙。14世纪70年代，毗奢耶那伽罗的库马拉·甘帕纳推翻了末代苏丹。他的妻子用梵文写过一部长诗，讲他重开米纳克希神庙，把穆斯林统治时藏起来的神像请回原处。

1529年起，纳亚克家族以毗奢耶那伽罗总督的身份坐镇于此，马杜赖重新成了王都。他们为神庙加筑围墙、扩大规模，添建了一座座门楼和柱廊大殿；其中最有作为的蒂鲁马莱·纳亚克把宫廷从蒂鲁奇拉帕利迁回，在城中建起宏大的王宫。1736年，昌达·萨希卜奉阿尔科特纳瓦卜之命俘虏了末代女王米纳克希，王朝就此终结。

english: Maduranthakam lies in the Tamil country beside a large irrigation tank. Its Eri-Katha Ramar temple honours Rama, whose local title means the protector of the lake. In a temple tradition, Rama and Lakshmana guarded the tank embankment during heavy rain, saving the settlement from a breach. The story binds the sacred site to the reservoir that has long sustained cultivation in the surrounding countryside.
simp_chinese: 马杜兰塔卡姆位于泰米尔地区一座大型灌溉水池旁。当地的埃里卡塔·拉玛神庙供奉罗摩，其称号意为“护湖的罗摩”。神庙传说讲述，罗摩和罗什曼那在大雨中守护水池堤坝，使聚落免于决堤之灾。这个故事将圣所与长期支持周围乡野耕作的水库联系起来。

english: Madwas lies in the uplands of eastern Baghelkhand, south of the Son River and west of the forested country of Sidhi. The region is part of the Vindhyan landscape of ridges and valleys between Rewa and the upper Son basin. Its villages stood within a wider country influenced by the Baghela rulers of Rewa, whose earlier seat was the fort of Bandhavgarh. Streams draining the uplands join the Son on its long course towards the Ganges.
simp_chinese: 马德瓦斯位于巴盖尔坎德东部高地，在松河南面、悉地森林地区以西。这片温迪亚山脊与谷地地带处在雷瓦和松河上游流域之间。村落所在的广大地区受到雷瓦巴盖拉统治者的影响，其早期驻地是班达夫加尔堡。从高地流下的溪流汇入松河，后者继续流向恒河。

english: Mae Hong Son lies in a mountainous region west of Chiang Mai, where forested ridges and river valleys extend towards the Salween. Shan communities lived in this borderland alongside other upland peoples. In 1831 an expedition from Chiang Mai gathered scattered Shan settlers and captured wild elephants here for training. The name Mae Hong Son recalls the stream beside which the elephants were taught and the settlement that grew around it.
simp_chinese: 夜丰颂位于清迈以西的山区，森林山岭和河谷向萨尔温江方向延伸。掸族社群与其他高地居民共同生活在这片边地。1831年，来自清迈的一支队伍将分散的掸族居民聚集起来，并在此捕捉、训练野象。夜丰颂之名让人想起训练大象的溪流，以及随之形成的聚落。

english:
Mae Sot belongs to the western Thai frontier near the Moei River, where valleys and mountain routes connected the Chao Phraya world with Burma. Farming settlements supplied food, while forest products and trade linked communities with different languages and political traditions. Paths through the hills gave local people an important role as guides, carriers and intermediaries between larger regional centres.

The wider frontier saw rivalry between Siamese and Burmese powers as well as movement and exchange across the hills. Some accounts identify Mae Sot with the older town of Mueang Chot.
simp_chinese:
湄索属于莫艾河附近泰国西部边疆，河谷和山路把昭披耶河世界与缅甸连接起来。农业聚落供应食物，林产品及贸易使语言和政治传统不同的社群相通。穿过丘陵的小径，使地方居民作为向导、运输者及较大区域中心之间的中间人具有重要作用。

更广阔的边疆经历暹罗与缅甸势力竞争，山地之间也存在人口往来和交换。有些记载将湄索等同于古城孟措。

english: Maerkang lies in the valleys of the Suomo River in the eastern Tibetan highlands. The river flows west past Zhuokeji, where it meets the Xisuo, and through the settlement of Maerkang. This was part of the Gyalrong Tibetan country governed by local hereditary chiefs. Four chiefdoms in the surrounding region were Zhuokeji, Songgang, Dangba and Suomo. Their fortified residences and tall stone towers marked seats of authority above the villages, while the valleys below supported farming and the higher lands pasture.
simp_chinese: 马尔康位于藏地东部高山间的梭磨河谷。河水向西流过卓克基，在那里与西索河相会，继而流经马尔康。这里属于嘉绒藏地，历史上由世袭土司治理；周边有卓克基、松岗、党坝和梭磨四土司。土司官寨及高耸的石碉屹立于村寨之上，是地方权力的所在；谷地可供耕作，更高处则有牧场。

english: Maevatanana lies in northwestern Madagascar between the Ikopa and Betsiboka rivers. Their waters drain from the central highlands towards Bombetoka Bay and the Mozambique Channel. The surrounding rocks and river deposits contain gold, carried in part by the streams of the region. The river valleys form a broad passage between the inland plateau and the Sakalava country closer to the western coast.
simp_chinese: 马埃瓦塔纳纳位于马达加斯加西北部，坐落在伊库帕河与贝齐布卡河之间。两河将中央高地的水流带向崩贝图卡湾和莫桑比克海峡。周围岩层和河流沉积物中含有金，一部分随当地溪流搬运。河谷在内陆高原与更靠近西岸的萨卡拉瓦地区之间形成宽阔通道。

english: Maewo is a long, narrow island in northern Vanuatu, east of Ambae. Mountainous and well watered, it has streams descending from wooded slopes towards the sea. In 1768 Louis Antoine de Bougainville passed the island and named it Aurora during his voyage through the archipelago. Its communities maintained their own languages and relationships with neighbouring islands.
simp_chinese: 马埃沃是瓦努阿图北部一座狭长岛屿，位于奥巴以东。岛上多山、雨水充足，溪流从林木山坡流向海洋。1768年，路易·安托万·德·布干维尔航经群岛时经过此岛，并将其命名为奥罗拉。岛上社群保有自己的语言，并与邻岛维持联系。

english: Mafia Channel runs between Mafia Island and the Rufiji River delta on the East African mainland. Bwejuu Island lies within the channel, whose waters connect the delta and nearby islands to the Indian Ocean. The Mafia archipelago belonged to the maritime world of the Swahili coast, where boats linked island and mainland communities with more distant ports. On Juani Island, east of Mafia, the old settlement of Kua suffered an attack by raiders from Madagascar in the 1820s, according to the island's recorded history. That event belongs to the wider archipelago rather than the channel itself. The waterway's position beside the river mouth made it part of the local connections between coast, delta and islands.
simp_chinese: 马菲亚海峡位于马菲亚岛与东非大陆的鲁菲吉河三角洲之间，布韦朱岛坐落在海峡内。水道将河口与附近岛屿接向印度洋。马菲亚群岛属于斯瓦希里海岸的海上世界，船只把岛屿、大陆社群和更远的港口联系起来。马菲亚岛以东的胡阿尼岛有库阿旧聚落；据岛屿历史记载，那里在十九世纪二十年代遭到来自马达加斯加的袭击。这一事件发生于更广的群岛，并非海峡本身。海峡靠近河口的位置，使它成为海岸、三角洲和岛屿之间地方联系的一部分。

english: Mafia Island lies off the East African coast, separated from the mainland by a channel near the Rufiji delta. Its southern waters contain reefs, mangroves and smaller islands around Chole Bay. Swahili settlements on the islands traded along the coast and across the Indian Ocean; the old town of Kua on Juani Island had mosques and stone buildings. Fishing and sailing linked the archipelago to the neighbouring mainland.
simp_chinese: 马菲亚岛位于东非海岸之外，海峡将它与鲁菲吉河三角洲附近的大陆隔开。岛屿南方的乔莱湾周围分布礁石、红树林和小岛。群岛上的斯瓦希里聚落沿海岸及跨印度洋贸易，胡阿尼岛的古城夸有清真寺和石造建筑。捕鱼与航海将群岛与邻近大陆联系起来。

english: The Laklãnõ, also known as Xokleng, inhabited the forested uplands of southern Brazil between the Paraná plateau and the Atlantic coast. Their territory included river valleys and mountains where araucaria forest alternated with open fields. From the eighteenth century, roads and cattle estates expanded through the highlands, bringing conflict and increasing pressure on Indigenous lands.
simp_chinese: 拉克拉诺人也称肖克伦人，居住在巴西南部巴拉那高原与大西洋海岸之间的森林高地。其领地包括河谷和山地，南洋杉林与开阔原野相间。自十八世纪起，道路和养牛庄园向高地扩张，带来了冲突，使原住民土地受到越来越大的压力。

english: The Magadanka reaches the Sea of Okhotsk beside Nagayev Bay, an inlet on the northern coast of the sea. Hills surround the sheltered waters, while river valleys extend inland into the mountainous country of northeastern Siberia. The coast belongs to the wider region of Tauy Bay, where the sea meets a landscape of wooded slopes and rivers. Long winters and the northern sea shape the shores of this remote inlet.
simp_chinese: 马加丹卡河在纳加耶沃湾附近注入鄂霍次克海。海湾深入北岸，丘陵环绕较为隐蔽的水域，河谷则向内陆延伸，通往西伯利亚东北部的山地。这片海岸属于更广阔的陶伊湾地区，海洋在此与森林山坡和河流相接。漫长冬季和北方海洋塑造了这座偏远海湾的岸线。

english: Mountain ridges and plateaus rise inland from the northern shore of the Sea of Okhotsk. Broad valleys break the high country, carrying rivers toward the coast. The Yama rises on the southwestern slopes of the Maymandzhin Range and flows south toward Shelikhov Gulf. Forest and open uplands cover this remote region, where the mountains separate the coastal watersheds from the rivers of the Siberian interior.
simp_chinese: 鄂霍次克海北岸内陆耸立着山脉与高原，宽阔河谷切开高地，把河水送往海岸。雅马河发源于迈曼津山脉西南坡，向南流往舍利霍夫湾。森林与开阔高地覆盖这片偏远地区，群山分隔着海岸水系与西伯利亚内陆河流。

english:
Magadi was the seat of the Kempe Gowda family west of Bangalore, with a fort and temples set amid the hills of the Karnataka plateau. After losing Bangalore, the family established itself here and held the nearby hill stronghold of Savandurga. The family had built its power around Bangalore before withdrawing to Magadi. The Ranganathaswamy temple at Tirumale and the fortified hills recall the local chiefs who governed the country under and after Vijayanagara.

In 1728 Devaraja, commander of the Mysore ruler, attacked Magadi and forced its chief to surrender. Savandurga and the wealth accumulated by the family also fell into Mysore’s hands. The defeated Kempe Gowda was taken to Srirangapatna as a prisoner, ending the family’s long rule over Magadi.
simp_chinese:
马加迪位于班加罗尔以西，曾是肯佩·高达家族的驻地，堡垒和神庙坐落在卡纳塔克高原的丘陵之间。家族失去班加罗尔后在此立足，并掌管附近的萨万杜尔加要塞。这一家族原先围绕班加罗尔建立权势，后来退居马加迪。蒂鲁马莱的兰伽纳塔斯瓦米神庙和设防山丘，让人想起在毗奢耶那伽罗统治时期及其后管理这片地区的地方首领。

1728年，迈索尔统治者的将领德瓦拉杰攻击马加迪，迫使当地首领投降。萨万杜尔加和家族积累的财富也落入迈索尔之手。战败的肯佩·高达被押往室利兰伽帕特纳囚禁，家族对马加迪的长期统治随之结束。

english: The Magaguadavic flows south from its lake through the wooded St. Croix Highlands to Passamaquoddy Bay. Its Passamaquoddy name means “river of eels”, recalling the fish found in its waters. Near the coast the river descends through a rocky gorge and falls before reaching the tidal bay. After the American Revolution, the river figured in a dispute over the boundary named in the 1783 Treaty of Paris: American negotiators argued that the Magaguadavic was the St. Croix, while Britain maintained that the Schoodic was the intended river.
simp_chinese: 马加瓜达维克河从同名湖流出，向南穿过林木覆盖的圣克罗伊高地，注入帕萨马科迪湾。河名在帕萨马科迪语中意为“鳗鱼之河”，使人想起水中的鱼类。河流接近海岸时经过岩石峡谷和瀑布，随后流入受潮汐影响的海湾。美国独立战争后，这条河卷入1783年《巴黎条约》边界的争议：美国谈判者认为它就是条约所说的圣克罗伊河，英国则主张指的是舒迪克河。

english:
Magalo lies on the northwestern side of Mount Arayat, the solitary volcanic mountain rising above the central plains of Luzon. The name is associated with a Kapampangan word for movement, recalling the swift and dangerous flow of the Parua River. Augustinian missionaries separated Magalang from Arayat as a town in 1605. The fields of the plain and the mountain's wooded slopes gave its people contrasting landscapes within a short distance.

The later city of Angeles City lies here.
simp_chinese:
马加洛位于阿拉亚特山西北侧，这座孤立的火山耸立在吕宋中央平原之上。地名与邦板牙语中表示运动的词有关，让人想起帕鲁阿河湍急危险的水流。1605年，奥思定会传教士将马加朗从阿拉亚特分出，设为城镇。平原上的田地与山上森林覆盖的坡地近在咫尺，为居民提供了不同的环境。

后来的安赫莱斯即位于此地。

english: Magan lies northwest of Yakutsk in the Tuymaada valley, among pine woods interspersed with birch. Its Sakha name means “white”. The locality stands beside Lake Khomustakh, a small lake formed by thawing permafrost, on a terrace above the Lena's floodplain. Winter here is long and severe, while the short summer can bring considerable warmth.
simp_chinese: 马甘位于雅库茨克西北的图伊马阿达河谷，松林间夹杂着桦树。其萨哈语名称意为“白色”。当地坐落于霍穆斯塔赫湖畔，这座小湖由永久冻土融化形成，位于勒拿河洪泛平原上方的阶地。这里冬季漫长严酷，短暂的夏季却可以相当温暖。

english: Maganasipi, the “wolf river”, runs through the wooded uplands north of the Ottawa River. Its eastern and western branches join a waterway that drains a lake of the same name into the Ottawa. The valley belongs to Algonquin country, where rivers and portages carried people between hunting grounds and neighbouring watersheds. During the seventeenth century, canoe flotillas on the Ottawa carried furs towards French trading centres and returned with goods for exchange inland.
simp_chinese: 马加纳西比意为“狼河”，流经渥太华河以北林木覆盖的高地。东、西支流汇入主河道，再把同名湖泊的水送往渥太华河。河谷属于阿尔冈昆人的土地，河流与搬舟小径连接猎场和相邻流域。十七世纪，渥太华河上的独木舟船队把毛皮运往法国贸易中心，再带回货物供内陆交换。

english: The Magdalenas are a group of islands in the Pacific off the coast of Nayarit, later known as the Islas Marías. In 1532 Diego Hurtado de Mendoza sailed north on an expedition sent by Hernán Cortés and gave the archipelago the name Magdalenas. His voyage continued along the coast amid storms, shortages and mutiny, and ended in disaster for the ships and their crews.
simp_chinese: 马格达莱纳斯群岛位于纳亚里特海岸外的太平洋中，后来称为马里亚斯群岛。1532年，埃尔南·科尔特斯派出的迭戈·乌尔塔多·德·门多萨率船北航，将这片群岛命名为马格达莱纳斯。他的船队继续沿海前进，途中遭遇风暴、物资短缺和哗变，航行最终以船只及船员的灾难告终。

english:
Magdeburg stands on the Elbe, where Otto the Great, buried in the cathedral beside his first wife Edith in 973, had made it the seat of an archbishopric in 968, and where the missionary Adalbert became its first archbishop. In the late Middle Ages it was one of the largest cities in the Empire, a Hanseatic member and the leader of the Saxon cities, and its municipal law, the Magdeburg Law, was adopted in towns far to the east. In 1207 a fire had burned much of the city together with the Ottonian cathedral, and the Gothic cathedral that replaced it rose through the fourteenth century.

The burghers' quarrels with their archbishop were constant. Around 1430 city and archbishop fought a war that the Council of Basel tried to end, and in 1493 the Jew-hating Archbishop Ernest II of Saxony expelled all Jews from the archbishopric. In 1503 the archbishop moved his residence to Halle, leaving the city to a government of three councils in the fifteenth century: a ruling council, an old council and a senior council.

Luther preached repeatedly in the city from June 1524, and on 17 July 1524 the Reformation was introduced in all its churches except the cathedral. Magdeburg became a centre of the Schmalkaldic League and of resistance to re-Catholicization. In the Thirty Years' War, imperial troops of the Catholic League under Tilly stormed and devastated it on 20 May 1631, the “Magdeburg wedding.” In 1680 the secularized archbishopric passed to Brandenburg, which made the city into the strongest fortress of the Prussian kingdom, and the Edict of Potsdam of 1685 brought a French colony. In 1807 it became the seat of the Elbe department of the Kingdom of Westphalia, and from 1814 it was Prussian again.
simp_chinese:
马格德堡位于易北河畔，奥托大帝于968年在此设立大主教区，973年他去世后与第一任妻子伊迪丝一同安葬在主教座堂内，曾赴罗斯传教的阿达尔贝特成为首任大主教。在中世纪晚期，它是帝国最大的城市之一，是汉萨同盟成员和萨克森城市的领袖，它的城市法《马格德堡法》被远在东方的许多城镇采纳。1207年的一场大火烧毁了城市的大部分，包括奥托时代的大教堂，取而代之的哥特式主教座堂在14世纪里逐渐建成。

市民与大主教的争执从未停息。约1430年城市与大主教发生战争，巴塞尔会议曾试图平息；1493年仇视犹太人的萨克森的恩斯特二世大主教驱逐了大主教区内所有犹太人。1503年大主教把驻地迁往哈雷，把城市留给自己治理；15世纪的市政由执政议会、旧议会和上议会三个议会共同承担。

从1524年6月起，路德多次在城中布道，1524年7月17日，除主教座堂外的所有教堂都引入了宗教改革。马格德堡成了施马尔卡尔登同盟和反抗重新天主教化的中心。三十年战争中，天主教联盟的帝国军队在蒂利率领下，于1631年5月20日攻入并摧毁了该城，这就是“马格德堡的婚礼”。1680年，世俗化的大主教区转归勃兰登堡，勃兰登堡把这座城市建成普鲁士王国最强大的要塞，1685年《波茨坦敕令》又带来法国移民区。1807年它成为威斯特法伦王国易北省的省会，1814年起重回普鲁士。

english: Magé lies near the northern shore of Guanabara Bay, below the forested mountains of the Serra do Mar. Simão da Mota established a residence on a land grant here in 1565, beginning a colonial settlement in the area. In the eighteenth century a route opened by Bernardo de Proença crossed the mountains toward Minas Gerais, while the riverside port of Estrela served traffic between Rio de Janeiro and the mines.
simp_chinese: 马热位于瓜纳巴拉湾北岸附近，坐落在森林覆盖的海岸山脉脚下。1565年，西芒·达莫塔在获赐土地上建立住宅，开启了当地的殖民定居。十八世纪，贝尔纳杜·迪普罗恩萨开辟的道路翻越群山，通往米纳斯吉拉斯；埃斯特雷拉河港则为里约热内卢与矿区之间的交通服务。

english: Maghana, also called Maghama, lies near the Senegal River in the Sahelian country of the Gorgol. The settlement stands by a tributary leading towards the river’s floodplain, where seasonal waters support cultivation and grazing. Toucouleur communities inhabit this part of the valley, whose villages lie between the desert to the north and the savanna to the south. The Senegal provides a long-standing route of movement and exchange through the region.
simp_chinese: 马加纳又称马加马，位于塞内加尔河附近的戈尔戈勒萨赫勒地区。聚落靠近一条流向河流洪泛平原的支流，季节性水源支持耕作与放牧。图库洛尔社群居住在这一河谷地带，村庄介于北方沙漠与南方草原之间。塞内加尔河长期是穿越地区的人口往来和交换通道。

english: Magherafelt lies west of Lough Neagh amid the farmland of southern Derry. Known as a town in the fifteenth century, it was reshaped during the plantation of Ulster, when London companies acquired land in the district. The Salters' Company became a major landholder here. Its surviving records include a 1615 agreement with an agent for building Magherafelt and nearby Salterstown, followed by a formal grant of land in 1618. The town's market and streets grew within an estate whose management linked local tenants to the London company.
simp_chinese: 马拉费尔特位于内伊湖以西，周围是德里南部农田。十五世纪已有城镇记载；阿尔斯特殖民安置期间，伦敦同业公会取得当地土地，城镇面貌随之改变。盐商公会成为这里的重要地主。其留存档案包括1615年与代理人订立的建设马拉费尔特及附近索尔特斯敦的协议，以及1618年正式取得土地的记录。市集与街道在庄园内发展，庄园管理将当地佃户与伦敦公会联系起来。

english: The Magnetawan River runs west through lakes, rapids and forest to Georgian Bay. Its name is commonly explained as swift-flowing water, fitting a river that descends from the interior to the bay. The watershed is part of the ancestral country of the Anishinaabeg; the Shawanaga people remember their territory extending north to the Magnetawan and east towards the Ottawa valley. The river provided a route through the forest and places for hunting, fishing and trade.
simp_chinese: 马格内塔万河向西穿过湖泊、急流和森林，注入乔治亚湾。河名通常被解释为“湍急的水”，与河流从内陆奔向海湾的景象十分贴切。流域属于阿尼希纳贝人的祖传土地；沙瓦纳加人记得，他们的活动区域向北延伸到马格内塔万河，向东通往渥太华河谷。这条河提供了穿越森林的路线，也有狩猎、捕鱼和交换的场所。

english:
Magón was an Indigenous district of south-central Cuba, remembered in accounts of the island before the Spanish conquest. Early historical descriptions place it south of Cubanacán, between Guamuhaya to the west and Ornofay to the east. This country extends from the interior toward the shallow waters of the southern coast, where cays fringe the sea. Its old name preserves a piece of the island’s Indigenous geography.

The later city of Sancti Spíritus lies here.
simp_chinese:
马贡是古巴中南部的原住民地区，有关西班牙征服之前岛屿的记载保存了它的名称。早期历史描述将它置于古巴纳坎以南、西侧瓜穆哈亚与东侧奥尔诺费之间。这里从内陆延伸至南岸浅海，沿海分布着礁岛；古老名称留存了岛屿原住民地理的一部分。

后来的圣斯皮里图斯即位于此地。

english:
Magorix is associated with the Macorix peoples of northern Hispaniola, whom early chroniclers distinguished from neighboring Taíno speakers. Their communities inhabited a region of northern coasts and valleys, and Bartolomé de las Casas described their language as different from that spoken elsewhere on the island. The name preserves evidence of the linguistic diversity of Hispaniola before Spanish conquest transformed its Indigenous societies.

The later city of San Fernando de Monte Cristi lies here.
simp_chinese:
马戈里克斯与伊斯帕尼奥拉北部的马科里克斯人有关，早期编年史家将他们与讲泰诺语的邻居区分开来。他们的社群居住在北部海岸与河谷地区，巴托洛梅·德拉斯卡萨斯称其语言不同于岛屿其他地方的语言。这个名称保留了西班牙征服改变原住民社会之前岛屿语言多样性的证据。

后来的蒙特克里斯蒂即位于此地。

english: The Magpie uplands rise in the forested interior north of the Gulf of St. Lawrence. Through this country runs Mutehekau Shipu, the river known in English as the Magpie. Its Innu name describes water passing between square rock cliffs, a striking feature of its course toward the gulf. The river and its valleys belong to Nitassinan, the ancestral territory of the Innu of Ekuanitshit, whose journeys connect the inland lakes with the coast.
